title: IT Services Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
  
  
**IT Services Engineer**
**Job Description**
Deliver reliable, secure, and responsive end-user support while maintaining core workplace technology services. The role covers hardware, software, identity and access, Microsoft 365, collaboration and conferencing platforms, employee lifecycle activities, and IT service operations, with a strong focus on executive support and a seamless user experience across office and remote environments.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Provide onsite and remote technical support for laptops, desktops, Windows and macOS, applications, mobile devices, printers, and peripherals.
* Manage incidents and service requests through the ITSM platform within defined SLAs, ensuring accurate categorization, prioritization, documentation, routing, resolution, and escalation.
* Administer identity and access, including application assignments, group memberships, MFA, SSO, and authentication issues, and support onboarding, transfers, contractor setup, and offboarding.
* Support Microsoft 365 services (Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Intune), including shared mailboxes, distribution groups, permissions, archives, and licensing.
* Deliver white-glove support for executives and VIP users, ensuring technology readiness for executive meetings, presentations, and visits.
* Support and troubleshoot Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Zoom Rooms, and conference room AV, and provide live support for town halls, training sessions, and key business meetings.
* Perform proactive conference room and meeting technology checks to minimize disruption.
* Deploy and maintain endpoints and peripherals, and support asset inventory, hardware lifecycle, device compliance, patching, and endpoint readiness.
* Participate in the weekend on-call rotation to handle critical incidents, perform initial troubleshooting, coordinate escalations, and restore service quickly.
* Create and maintain SOPs, knowledge articles, FAQs, and user guides, and contribute to improvements in support quality, self-service, and operational efficiency.
* Follow corporate security standards, access-control requirements, and IT policies.

**Required Qualifications**

* 2–5 years of experience in IT support, end-user services, or workplace technology operations.
* Strong hands-on experience troubleshooting and supporting Windows 11 and macOS (Iru or similar macOS management tools).
* Proven experience with Microsoft 365 administration and user support.
* Working knowledge of Active Directory, Okta SSO, MFA, account administration, and access troubleshooting.
* Experience with FreshService, Jira, or a similar ITSM platform.
* Working knowledge of Intune, MECM, or comparable endpoint-management tools.
* Foundational knowledge of networking, hardware, conferencing, and audiovisual support.
* Excellent communication, customer-service, and documentation skills, with the ability to stay composed in high-pressure situations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting executives and VIP users in a white-glove service model.
* Hands-on experience with Zoom Rooms, Teams Rooms, and enterprise conference room AV systems.
* Experience supporting large-scale events such as town halls and all-hands meetings.
* Exposure to Okta administration, automation, or scripting (e.g., PowerShell, Bash) to improve support efficiency.
* Relevant certifications such as Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate, ITIL Foundation, CompTIA A+, or Apple Certified Support Professional.

**Educational Qualification**
BE/B.Tech/BCA/MCA or B.Sc., preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

title: Senior IT Services Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
  
  
**Senior IT Services Engineer**
**Job Description**
Serve as a technical leader within IT Services, resolving complex issues, leading service and platform improvements, and advancing automation across identity, endpoint, collaboration, employee lifecycle, and ITSM services. The role owns advanced Windows and macOS endpoint management, including MacBook fleet administration through Iru, mentors engineers, strengthens operational governance, and delivers a secure, reliable, and high-quality user experience, including white-glove support for executives and critical business events.

* Lead troubleshooting for complex incidents affecting users, endpoints, applications, identity, and collaboration services, acting as the escalation point for IT Services Engineers.
* Coordinate cross-functional resolution with Infrastructure, Security, Network, and Application teams.
* Administer and improve Okta SSO, MFA, application integrations, group management, and lifecycle processes, validating access configurations, attribute mappings, and provisioning and deprovisioning flows.
* Drive secure access practices, access reviews, audit readiness, and lifecycle governance.
* Manage advanced administration across Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Intune, Entra ID, and endpoint services, and lead device deployment, configuration, and service improvements.

* Strong hands-on experience administering Iru (formerly Kandji) to manage MacBooks at scale, including Blueprint design, automated device enrollment through Apple Business Manager, configuration profiles, custom scripts, app deployment, and macOS security and compliance.
* Hands-on experience with Okta SSO, SCIM, MFA, provisioning, deprovisioning, and application integrations.
* Strong ITSM platform knowledge, including FreshService configuration, dashboards, routing, and reporting.
* Experience with automation platforms, scripting, workflow design, and approved AI-enabled tools.
* Strong understanding of endpoint security, compliance controls, conferencing, Zoom Rooms, and audiovisual technologies.
* Strong customer-service orientation with clear verbal and written communication.
* Structured troubleshooting, sound judgment, attention to detail, and a strong sense of ownership.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with Okta Workflows.
* Scripting experience for macOS and Windows automation (e.g., Bash, zsh, Python, or PowerShell).
* Experience mentoring engineers and leading service or process improvement initiatives.
* Proven track record of delivering measurable automation and self-service outcomes.
* Experience supporting audits, access reviews, and security compliance programs.
* Certifications such as Okta Certified Administrator, Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator or Microsoft 365 Administrator, and ITIL Foundation or higher.
* Iru (Kandji) certifications or equivalent Apple credentials such as Apple Certified Support Professional (ACSP) or Apple Certified IT Professional.

**Success Measures**

* Service-level performance, ticket quality, and durable resolution of complex issues.
* Customer experience and reliability of end-user and workplace services.
* Endpoint compliance, security posture, and deployment efficiency across the Windows and macOS fleet.
* Automation adoption and measurable process-improvement outcomes.
* Quality and use of knowledge articles, SOPs, and operational documentation.

BE/B.Tech/BCA/MCA or B.Sc., preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

title: Technical Support Engineer - India
description:
**About The Role**
As a Technical Support Engineer at a pioneering AI company, you'll be the first line of defense to support customers as they build out training, fine tuning, and inference solutions with Together AI. You'll dive deep into complex technical challenges, providing swift and effective solutions while serving as a product expert. As a part of the Customer Experience organization, you will collaborate closely with product and sales, driving continuous improvement of our offerings. This is an exciting opportunity for a deeply technical professional passionate about AI and customer success to make a significant impact in a fast-paced, innovative environment.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Triage and respond to inbound support tickets across self-serve and enterprise customers using a support/CRM platform; identify patterns in ticket clusters (e.g., a wave of the same error code), surface them to engineering with context and affected case lists, and follow through to resolution.
* Draft clear, accurate status updates and maintenance notifications for customers during planned maintenance windows or incidents; communicate expected impact without exposing internal platform details.
* Collaborate seamlessly across Engineering, Research, and Product teams to address customer concerns; collaborate with senior leaders both internally and externally to ensure the highest levels of customer satisfaction.
* Answer customer questions about the platform's API, model/fine-tuning workflows, model availability, and deployment/endpoint configuration; reproduce reported errors to confirm expected vs. broken behavior and provide actionable next steps.
* Provision and configure SSO connections for enterprise customers (Google Workspace, Okta, Azure AD, etc.); guide customers through IdP-side setup steps; diagnose login failures by cross-referencing the platform's identity provider configuration against the customer's; escalate confirmed platform-side gaps.
* Triage customer billing questions using billing/subscription tooling (e.g., Stripe, Metronome, or equivalent); process or coordinate refunds for prepaid credits and disputed charges; investigate negative-balance and credit-limit enforcement issues; escalate edge cases to the billing/finance team with full context.
* Resolve API key creation failures, org linkage issues, and project/key limit requests; coordinate user access changes (adding/removing org members, SSO org ownership transfers); investigate tenant isolation issues.

**Requirements**

* 2+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role
* Comfortable reading and writing curl/HTTP requests, interpreting JSON error responses, and understanding concepts like bearer tokens, rate limits, and API key scoping; no deep software engineering background required, but must be able to follow and reproduce API-level issues.
* Familiarity with how SaaS billing works (invoices, prepaid credits, refunds); comfortable navigating admin dashboards and understanding what a payment state means.
* Working knowledge of SAML and OIDC concepts (ACS URL, audience URI, attribute mapping, IdP vs. SP); enough to walk a customer's IT admin through a configuration and recognize whether an error is on the customer side or platform side.
* Familiarity with infrastructure services (e.g., Kubernetes, SLURM), infrastructure as code solutions (e.g., Ansible) high-performance network fabrics, NFS-based storage management, container infrastructure, and scripting and programming languages.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Prior experience with a customer support platform (Zendesk, Intercom, Pylon, Freshdesk, or similar); comfortable managing a queue, updating ticket state, and writing internal notes.
* Familiarity with how language model APIs work (tokens, context windows, serverless vs. dedicated inference)
* Strong sense of ownership and willingness to learn new skills to ensure both team and customer success.
* Ability to operate in dynamic environments, adept at managing multiple projects, and comfortable with frequent context switching and prioritization.

**About Together AI**
Together AI is a research-driven artificial intelligence company. We believe open and transparent AI systems will drive innovation and create the best outcomes for society, and together we are on a mission to significantly lower the cost of modern AI systems by co-designing software, hardware, algorithms, and models. We have contributed to leading open-source research, models, and datasets to advance the frontier of AI, and our team has been behind technological advancement such as FlashAttention, Hyena, FlexGen, and RedPajama. We invite you to join a passionate group of researchers in our journey in building the next generation AI infrastructure.
  
  
**Compensation**
We offer competitive compensation, startup equity, health insurance, and other benefits, as well as flexibility in terms of remote work. Our salary ranges are determined by location, level and role. Individual compensation will be determined by experience, skills, and job-related knowledge.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity**
Together AI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and more.
  
  
Please see our Privacy Policy at https://www.together.ai/privacy

title: GMS-Senior-BeyondTrust

title: L2 Technical Support
description:
**Who we are**

Mindtickle is the leading AI-powered revenue enablement platform, helping sales teams learn faster, practice smarter, and perform at their best. We bring together onboarding, training, coaching, content, digital sales rooms, conversation intelligence, and AI role-plays into one platform so revenue teams have everything they need to build winning sellers.

Global companies, like Fortune 500 organizations, trust Mindtickle to support their revenue teams. Customers and industry analysts have also recognized us. G2 has ranked us the #1 Sales Training & Onboarding platform for 28 consecutive quarters, and Forrester has recognized Mindtickle as a Leader in revenue enablement. Mindtickle was also recognized as AI-Based Sales Solution of the Year by the 2025 AI Breakthrough Awards and has received Stevie Awards for Technology Innovation and Customer Support Excellence.

At Mindtickle, we're helping companies create high-performing revenue teams, and we're looking for people who want to help shape what's next.

**Job Brief**

Mindtickle is hiring an experienced Customer Support Engineer - II to join our Customer Support Engineering team and become the technical heartbeat behind a global enterprise SaaS platform and our award-winning AI solutions. In this role, you will troubleshoot and resolve complex issues in a distributed system across backend services, APIs, data platform, UI interactions, and AI-powered solutions.

This role demands a strong working knowledge of cloud fundamentals: debugging of distributed systems, querying and analyzing system data, logs, and traces, writing scripts, and resolving complex backend and frontend issues with precision and speed. You will collaborate directly with Engineering, Product, Quality Engineering, and DevOps, influencing product quality and strengthening customer trust at scale.

If you thrive in solving hard technical problems, working with cross-functional teams, excel in high-stakes scenarios, owning outcomes end-to-end, and delighting customers, this role offers unparalleled influence and impact that few L2 positions can match.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Operational Support and Issue Ownership**

* Respond rapidly to customer queries and drive issues to resolution.
* Provide timely workarounds and temporary solutions to customers for known issues, ensuring minimal disruption while long-term fixes are being implemented.
* Own support tickets end-to-end, ensuring SLA compliance and serving as an escalation point.
* Work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, QE and DevOps to eliminate systemic issues and reduce ticket volume.
* Work independently with strong planning and task management skills.
* Use data analysis to make actionable, data-driven recommendations.

**Technical Investigation, Diagnostics and Root Cause Analysis**

* Diagnose, reproduce, and debug complex issues across backend services, APIs, data flows, UI behavior, and AI-driven components.

* **1-3 years**
  **L2**
  technical support experience in enterprise SaaS platforms/products (AWS Cloud preferred) in a customer-facing role.

title: Junior Digital Buildings System Engineer
description:
At FPC Global, we’re not just shaping the future—we’re building it. Our mission, "Building Tomorrow’s Digital Planet," reflects our unwavering commitment to transforming industries, creating smarter spaces, and driving sustainable progress.

Since our founding in 2014, we have grown into a global leader with over 140 exceptional professionals, operating across the Americas, EMEA, APAC, and with our headquarters in London. We specialize in delivering integrated, cutting-edge consultancy services that span the entire facility lifecycle, ensuring that every project we undertake sets a new standard for innovation and excellence.

Our business thrives on two dynamic pillars:

* **FPC Global**

The

Leveraging expertise in building automation technologies and communication protocols, the engineer connects disparate systems regardless of brand or manufacturer, enabling secure and optimized data flow for real-time analytics, remote monitoring, and enhanced operational efficiency.

In this highly technical role, you will collaborate with global teams in IT, security, networking, and infrastructure to deliver IoT and cloud-based solutions for a global office portfolio. You’ll demonstrate adaptability by learning and working across multiple cloud environments (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and diverse BMS and IoT systems. Success requires a fast learner with strong communication skills, able to respond to shifting priorities and make informed decisions quickly, even with limited information. This role supports digital transformation for smart buildings, creating data-driven, future-ready facility management solutions

The responsibilities for this role include:

To ensure smooth integration, optimization, and security of applications on cloud platforms. Troubleshoot issues, manage performance, and align cloud solutions with business objectives. * Preferred knowledge of Apps Scripts

* Conduct pre- and post-onboarding testing to validate data integrity and system performance.
* Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve issues related to data transmission, system compatibility, and network connectivity.
* **Documentation & Reporting:**
* Maintain comprehensive documentation of onboarding processes, system configurations, and cloud settings.
* Generate regular reports on onboarding status, system performance, and key metrics
* **FPC Responsibilities:**

* Be an effective Digital Building Services team member, communicating with colleagues and working collectively to contribute to the development of Digital Buildings Services Group and the FPC business as a whole
* Report to line manager, acting in accordance with their requests and direction and those of FPC management

title: Technical Support Specialist
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Technical Support Specialist plays a pivotal role in fostering OpenGov's business growth. You'll connect with government leaders across the country, training and supporting them in OpenGov products to transform how they serve their communities. The ideal candidate should possess a technical degree (Computer Science degree preferred), be energized by analytical problem solving, and be interested in learning about and using AI to solve complex problems.
  
  
This entry-level position is designed for individuals eager to learn and grow within a fast-paced environment. You’ll receive hands-on training, mentorship, and clear pathways for advancement.
  
  
The Technical Support Specialist provides our customers omni-channel support via Phone, Chat, Web, and Email. The Technical Support Specialist independently manages their case backlog by assessing, analyzing, and providing technical expertise towards resolution while delivering high customer satisfaction. This position also requires providing technical guidance up to including impromptu software training.
  
  
This position will be in-shift, and after fully trained on the product and support operations, become 3rd Shift, remote. Training will occur in our Pune Office during standard IST hours. Remote is implied until such time when business operations permit 3rd Shift in Office.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Provide customer technical support via omnichannel interactions in order to achieve key performance goals, ensuring customer interactions are addressed in a timely and accurate manner and meeting or exceeding service levels.
* Utilize service management system (Salesforce Service Cloud) for case management by providing adequate log notes, timely case updates, and work towards First Contact Resolution (FCR) for incoming inquiries to Support.
* Independently assess and prioritize incoming cases, applying technical judgment to determine appropriate resolutions or escalations.
* Triage customer reported incidents for severity, urgency and content to ensure consistency and quality.
* Perform research across various tools to determine if the incident is a known issue or defect.
* Troubleshoot a wide range of technologies and replicate incidents versus the expected results and document steps to reproduce.
* Provide technical guidance and software training to customers and internal teams, influencing best practices and support strategies.
* Contribute to the existing knowledge base to support customer self-service and training.

**Job Title: Technical Support Specialist**
Support Tier/Level: 1
  
  

* Participate in scheduled training sessions to learn internal and proprietary technologies.
* Utilizing AI tools to service more customers faster with higher quality.

**Requirements And Preferred Experience**

* Experience in working with/troubleshooting: Data Management, ETLWorks pipeline, API data failures, CSS Coding, and/or AP Invoicing, Utility Billing, Budgeting or Procurement Products/Software
* Interest in building strong interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills required.
* Strong technical aptitude to problem solve and understand complicated problem statements required.
* Ability to develop and maintain clear documentation for triaging, responding to, troubleshooting, and resolving issues.
* Excellent organizational, time-management, and prioritization skills required.
* Ability to collaborate and thrive within a team environment required.
* Ability to learn new technologies and concepts quickly required.
* Ability to handle multiple competing priorities required.
* Must be able to work specific shifts to provide support during business hours required.
* Participate in rotating on-call after business hours support required.
* Experience or interest in using AI

**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.
  
  
**Opportunity to Innovate**
The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**
This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.
  
  
**A Place to Make Your Mark**
We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.
  
  
**Benefits That Work For You**
Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:
  
  

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

title: Sr. Support Engineer, ERP
description:
**Organization Overview**
**Company Description**
QAD is building a world-class SaaS company, and we are growing. We are looking for talented individuals who want to join us on our mission to help solve relevant real-world problems in manufacturing and the supply chain.
  
  
**This hybrid position requires candidates to be based in Pune with 3-4 days of in-office collaboration per week.**
**Job Description**
The Senior Support Engineer, ERP role is a cornerstone within our organization, focused on delivering exceptional technical support for QAD and Progress products. In this role, you will engage directly with customers and partners through various communication platforms, such as CRM, telephone, email and internet-based tools, to address complex technical issues and inquiries related to QAD applications and Progress databases.
  
  
As an ERP Support Engineer, you will be responsible for diagnosing and resolving technical issues, ensuring seamless installations, upgrades, and configurations of QAD products. You will leverage your expertise to perform Progress DBA tasks, including database optimization, backups, and troubleshooting. This role also demands strict adherence to quality standards, processes, and tools established by the company, ensuring consistent delivery of high-quality support.
  
  
Your responsibilities extend to managing highly complex and escalated cases, requiring innovative problem-solving and a deep understanding of QAD and Progress Products. You will play a pivotal role in creating and maintaining detailed documentation of issues and resolutions, which will serve as a foundation for developing training materials and reusable solutions. These resources will be shared globally to empower customers, partners, and internal teams with actionable knowledge.
  
  
Collaboration is a key component of this role, as you will work closely with team leads, peers, and cross-functional teams, including R&D and Product Management, to devise effective solutions and uphold superior support standards. Additionally, you will contribute to team growth by developing and sharing training content, focusing on complex case resolution and technical troubleshooting.
  
  
Given that our support organization operates 24/7, this position demands a flexible approach to scheduling. You will be expected to participate in shift rotations, along with weekend shifts and potential on-call coverage as required. These elements are vital to providing continuous support to our global customer base. Your willingness to adapt to these scheduling requirements is crucial for the role.
  
  
In a structured team environment, you will be encouraged to engage in continuous learning and regular practice of existing product knowledge. This is necessary to stay prepared for any new challenges that might arise. As a Sr. Functional Analyst, you have a unique opportunity to grow professionally while significantly contributing to the success of our clients and the organization
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Technical Support and Troubleshooting:
* Provide comprehensive technical assistance for QAD products, including installations, configurations, upgrades, and administration tasks.
* Analyze and resolve technical issues, applying advanced troubleshooting skills and root cause analysis to deliver effective and timely resolutions.
* Handle complex and escalated cases that require innovative problem-solving, ensuring adherence to Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and maintaining high customer satisfaction.
* Perform Progress DBA tasks, including database optimization, backup/restore operations, and monitoring database performance to prevent disruptions.
* Incident Handling:
* Manage incoming support requests through established ticketing systems and communication channels, ensuring accurate categorization and prioritization of issues.
* Escalate unresolved issues appropriately, collaborating with team leads and cross-functional departments to ensure timely resolutions.
* Proactively monitor incidents to identify recurring patterns, applying preventive measures to reduce repeat occurrences.
* Ensure that support incidents are resolved in line with established Service Level Agreements.
* Documentation and Knowledge Sharing:
* Maintain detailed and accurate documentation of all troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and best practices for every case handled.
* Contribute to the organization's knowledge base by documenting verified solutions, technical insights, and reusable resources.
* Develop comprehensive guides and FAQs to support customers, partners, and internal teams, ensuring quick access to relevant information.
* Customer Engagement and Communication:
* Communicate effectively with customers and partners to provide regular updates on issue resolution progress.
* Explain technical concepts in a clear and concise manner, ensuring that both technical and non-technical stakeholders understand the issue and the resolution.
* Foster trust and transparency with customers by maintaining a proactive approach and ensuring their concerns are addressed promptly.
* Collaboration and Teamwork:

title: Advanced Customer Support Engineer – Teamcenter
description:
**Role Description**
**Siemens Digital Industries Software**
We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation, helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while crafting a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.
  
  
**Position Overview**

* We are seeking a sophisticated Customer Support Engineer to join our Global Teamcenter Customer Support organization.
* This role is ideal for someone who already has a solid foundation in technical or application support and is ready to take the next step in their career. You will receive onboarding, product training, and continuous support from experienced engineers while developing deeper expertise in Siemens Teamcenter PLM Product and its supporting technologies.
* As a sophisticated Support Engineer, we are looking for someone who can learn quickly, take initiative, and progress toward working independently faster than an entry-level engineer.
* You will troubleshoot enterprise applications, infrastructure, configuration, integration, and performance-related issues across Linux and Windows environments. You will work directly with customers while collaborating with experienced Support Engineers, Product Development, Cloud/IT teams, and other specialists across our Global organization.
* Over time, you will be expected to independently manage increasingly complex customer cases, recognize when additional expertise is needed, and actively drive investigations toward resolution.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide technical support for Siemens Teamcenter and its supporting technologies.
* Investigate application, configuration, integration, infrastructure, and performance-related customer issues.
* Analyze application logs, configuration files, diagnostic data, error messages, thread dumps, and other technical information to identify possible causes and next troubleshooting steps.
* Troubleshoot issues across Linux and Windows environments, including application services, file systems, permissions, processes, connectivity, and resource utilization.
* Reproduce customer-reported issues in internal environments and develop clear test scenarios.
* Manage assigned customer cases and maintain ownership of investigation and communication through resolution.
* Prioritize multiple cases based on severity, customer impact, and business urgency. (Knowledge of SLA’s)
* Participate in technical critical issues and collaborate with senior Support Engineers, SME’s, Cloud Operations, IT, and other specialists when deeper expertise is required.
* Recognize when an issue may originate outside the application layer and collect the appropriate technical evidence before engaging other teams.
* Communicate investigation progress, technical findings, solutions, and next steps clearly to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Document troubleshooting steps, root-cause findings, solutions, and workarounds.
* Contribute to Knowledge Base articles and other reusable technical documentation.
* Identify recurring issues and opportunities to improve troubleshooting processes, documentation, and customer experience.
* Continuously develop technical knowledge of Teamcenter and its underlying technology stack.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience in technical support, application support, systems engineering, or a similar technical role.
* Experience troubleshooting enterprise or server-based software applications.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with a structured approach to technical problem solving.
* Solid understanding of Linux and Windows operating systems, including command-line tools, services, processes, permissions, and file systems.
* Understanding fundamental networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, proxies, firewalls, ports, certificates, and client/server communication.
* Experience reviewing and analyzing application or system logs.
* Ability to lead multiple technical issues and organize work according to priority and customer impact.
* Ability and willingness to learn new technologies quickly and apply new knowledge to customer problems.
* Initiative and the ability to work increasingly independently following the initial training and onboarding period.
* Good judgment in recognizing when additional technical expertise or customer concern is required.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Professional proficiency in English is required, as English is the primary working language across our global Support and Engineering organization.
* Ability to explain technical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to collaborate effectively within a geographically distributed global team.
* Ability and willingness to use AI technologies responsibly as part of day-to-day work to improve productivity, troubleshooting, documentation, and customer support outcomes.

**Preferred Qualifications**
Experience with one or more of the following is highly desirable:
  
  

* Java or Java-based enterprise applications, particularly application troubleshooting.
* Apache HTTP Server and web application architectures.
* SQL databases (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL)
* AWS or other cloud infrastructure and services.
* Enterprise authentication technologies such as SAML, OAuth/OIDC, LDAP, Active Directory, or SSO.
* SQL and basic database troubleshooting.
* JVM configuration, heap/thread dump analysis, or Java application performance troubleshooting.
* Load balancers, reverse proxies, SSL/TLS certificates, and enterprise network architectures

**Training and Development**

* We recognize that Teamcenter is a complex enterprise platform with a broad technology stack. New team members receive an onboarding and training period that includes product training, technical knowledge transfer, shadowing experienced engineers, and exposure to real customer cases.
* During onboarding, you will have access to experienced team members who can provide guidance and help you build product knowledge.
* Because this is an Advanced-level position, we expect you to build on your existing technical support experience, pick up new concepts quickly, become comfortable making technical decisions, and progress toward independently handling your workload and customer cases.
* Strong problem-solving skills are essential, including the ability to investigate complex issues, ask the right questions, research unfamiliar technologies, collaborate effectively with technical experts, and resolve appropriate next steps toward resolution.
* The position is based around Pacific (and/or Asia Pacific) Time Zone business hours, with some flexibility in the daily schedule. As part of a global organization, there may occasionally be opportunities to adjust your schedule slightly to collaborate with colleagues or attend meetings across different time zones.

**What Success Looks Like**

* As you complete onboarding and develop your Teamcenter knowledge, you will become increasingly comfortable managing customer cases independently.
* You will be able to assess an issue, collect the appropriate technical information, perform an initial investigation, and determine reasonable next troubleshooting steps. For more sophisticated issues, you will know when and how to collaborate with experienced engineers, Engineering, or other technical teams.
* You will have daily support, collaboration, and technical resources from your immediate team, as well as access to our global Support organization and domain experts across different regions and time zones. Our collaborative environment provides opportunities to learn from experienced colleagues, exchange knowledge, and work together on sophisticated technical challenges.
* Successful engineers in this role are curious, proactive, organized, accountable, and comfortable learning continuously. They take ownership for moving their cases forward while recognizing that sophisticated problems are often solved through teamwork.

**Why us?**
Working at Siemens Software means flexibility. Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software.
  
  
A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
  
  
**Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday**

title: Deputy Manager_Oracle Siebel CRM
description:
Who we are
  
  
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking an experienced
**Siebel CRM application operations professional**
to manage the day-to-day operational health and technical support of Oracle Siebel CRM and associated platforms from
**SP Infocity, Pune**
.
  
  
This hands-on role focuses on service stability, SLA adherence, major incident and problem resolution, proactive monitoring, technical troubleshooting, automation, operational governance and continual service improvement. You will act as a technical escalation point for complex production issues and work across Siebel CRM, Oracle BSS and connected technology teams.
  
  
You should bring
**6-8 years of Telecom IT, Oracle BSS or enterprise CRM application operations experience**
, including at least
**4**
**years of hands-on Oracle Siebel CRM production support experience**
. Working knowledge of SRE practices, observability and automation is important for improving reliability, service performance and operational efficiency.
  
  
What you will do
  
  
Application support and technical operations
  
  

* Manage day-to-day support and operational health of Oracle Siebel CRM services
* Act as the technical escalation point for complex incidents, service degradation and cross-system issues
* Coordinate P1/P2 incident triage, technical analysis, service restoration and timely stakeholder communication
* Perform detailed troubleshooting using Siebel logs, workflow and component analysis, Oracle SQL, Unix/Linux utilities and monitoring data
* Coordinate end-to-end diagnosis across FMW/AIA, OSM, BRM, WebLogic, database, infrastructure and network teams

SLA, service management and governance
  
  

* Track adherence to agreed incident response, restoration and service request SLAs
* Review service KPIs including availability, SLA compliance, incident trends, MTTR, MTTD, backlog and recurring failures
* Support weekly and monthly service reviews with concise reporting covering operational performance, risks, actions and dependencies
* Keep operational controls, runbooks, knowledge articles, support procedures and audit evidence current and ensure agreed processes are followed
* Support change and release governance through risk assessments, readiness checks, validation evidence and post-change monitoring

Problem management and continual improvement
  
  

* Lead technical investigations into recurring incidents and contribute to high-quality root cause analysis and preventive actions
* Maintain and prioritise a service-improvement backlog using incident trends, monitoring gaps and operational risks
* Identify opportunities to automate health checks, alert responses, reporting, housekeeping and repetitive support activities
* Improve monitoring coverage, alert quality, dashboards and early detection to reduce customer impact and operational effort
* Track corrective and preventive actions through to closure and validate that improvements deliver sustainable results

Team and stakeholder coordination
  
  

* Provide technical guidance, work-allocation support and knowledge sharing for application support engineers
* Collaborate with Service Management, Business, Architecture, Infrastructure, Security, Oracle and other support partners
* Escalate risks, capacity concerns, vendor dependencies and unresolved service issues through agreed governance channels

Who you are
  
  
Technical knowledge and experience
  
  

* You have 7–10 years' experience in Telecom IT, Oracle BSS or enterprise CRM application operations
* You have at least 5 years' hands-on Oracle Siebel CRM production support experience
* You have strong knowledge of Siebel CRM architecture, server components, configuration, Workflows, eScript, Business Services, EAI, Integration Objects, inbound/outbound web services and Open UI troubleshooting
* You understand Siebel administration, including component health, tasks, sessions, logs, parameters and environment checks
* You have strong Oracle SQL/PLSQL skills for data analysis, troubleshooting and performance investigation
* You can use Unix/Linux and Shell scripting for log analysis, health checks, housekeeping and operational automation
* You understand telecom order management, product catalogue, customer and service-request flows
* You can troubleshoot integrations involving FMW/AIA, OSM, BRM, WebLogic and downstream systems
* You have hands-on experience with one or more observability tools such as Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Splunk, Kibana, Grafana or Zabbix
* You understand cloud, containers and Kubernetes/OKE operations, including pod health, logs, events, resource usage and restart validation
* You have awareness of CI/CD, configuration control and rollback principles in an application-operations environment
* You have experience supporting business-critical services and resolving complex production incidents within SLA

Service management and collaboration
  
  

* You understand Incident, Major Incident, Problem, Change, Release and Service Request management
* You have working knowledge of the ITIL framework and production-operations controls
* You have experience with SLA/KPI tracking, service reporting and operational governance
* You can contribute to effective RCA, risk management and continual service improvement
* You can coordinate effectively with stakeholders, vendors and cross-functional teams
* You communicate technical and operational information clearly in writing and verbally
* Experience delivering measurable improvements through automation, monitoring or continual-service-improvement initiatives is important

**Preferred Qualifications And Experience**

* ITIL Foundation certification
* Exposure to Kubernetes/OKE, cloud operations, DevOps/SRE practices and enterprise observability tools
* Experience with telecom order management and Oracle BSS integrations

Not a Perfect Fit?
  
  
Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What’s In It For You**

* The opportunity to work hands-on with business-critical Oracle Siebel CRM and Oracle BSS services
* Exposure to complex, cross-platform telecom operations spanning FMW/AIA, OSM, BRM, WebLogic, databases, infrastructure and networks
* Opportunities to contribute to service reliability through SRE practices, observability, automation and continual service improvement
* Experience influencing improvements measured through availability, SLA compliance, MTTR, MTTD, incident recurrence and change stability
* Collaboration across Service Management, Business, Architecture, Infrastructure, Security, Oracle and other support partners

**What Skills You Will Learn**
Through the scope of this role, you will have opportunities to further develop:
  
  

* Advanced Siebel CRM production troubleshooting and service-stability practices
* Observability, monitoring and early-detection techniques across enterprise applications
* Operational automation using scripting, health checks and repeatable support procedures
* SRE and continual-service-improvement practices focused on reliability and reducing operational effort
* Kubernetes/OKE and cloud-operations knowledge, including pod health, logging, events and resource monitoring
* Cross-platform diagnosis across Oracle BSS and associated technologies
* Major incident coordination, problem management, RCA and operational governance

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.
  
  
**Join Us**
At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
  
  
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
  
  
With us, you can be truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

title: Ld Analyst Systems IT
description:
**Job Summary**
The Systems Analyst Lead role collaborates with business partners and application development teams to deliver and maintain required technology solutions. They are responsible for updates to applications / technology platforms, setting up monitoring, responding to issues, troubleshooting and general maintenance of the systems.
  
  
They will partner with the team manager on contributing to and implementing the business strategy chosen for the team. They will demonstrate ownership of a high number of strategic tasks for the team.
  
  
They will act as the liaison for various IT (Information Technology) infrastructure, security, and development teams. They will also be addressing any requests, inquiries, and escalations from customers, help desk, or business partners.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Summary**
Medline Industries, Inc. Information Services department is seeking a Lead for the TMS Applications team. This individual will report to the Manager - TMS Applications and will be expected to run the scrum team day to day, drive predictable delivery, and ensure the team continuously achieves and exceeds agreed delivery and support metrics. The role requires a hands-on technology and domain leader who can work closely with the TMS Manager, India and US counterparts, business partners, product owners, and technical teams to deliver high-quality solutions and ensure reliable application support.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the TMS scrum team day-to-day execution, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and follow-through on committed deliverables.
* Partner with the TMS Manager to monitor delivery metrics, support KPIs, quality indicators, velocity, productivity, and team capacity, and drive corrective actions where required.
* Ensure that delivery outcomes are predictable, transparent, and aligned with business priorities, committed timelines, and agreed quality standards.
* Coordinate application support activities for TMS and related logistics systems, ensuring timely triage, escalation, communication, resolution, and problem management for incidents and service requests.
* Develop hands-on expertise in the underlying TMS applications, integrations, data flows, business processes, and logistics domain so that the team receives strong technical and functional guidance.
* Work closely with US counterparts, product owners, business users, architects, QA, infrastructure, DevOps, and integration teams to remove blockers and align on solution approach.
* Promote Agile discipline, DevOps practices, documentation hygiene, test coverage, release readiness, and continuous improvement within the team.
* Provide guidance to team members, help build capability, encourage ownership, and support effective utilization of the team in consultation with the TMS Manager.
* Communicate clearly and proactively on status, risks, dependencies, support issues, delivery progress, and decisions needed from stakeholders.
* Maintain a professional demeanor and consistently interact productively with employees at all levels while adhering to Medline Code of Ethics and corporate policies.

**Key Areas of Responsibility**

* Scrum execution and delivery governance for the TMS application team, with clear ownership of sprint commitments and delivery metrics.
* Reliable support operations for TMS and related logistics applications, with focus on availability, incident cycle times, RCA quality, and stakeholder communication.
* Hands-on application and domain depth across TMS processes, integrations, configurations, data flows, and key upstream/downstream dependencies to be able to guide the team members in their work deliverables
* Continuous improvement across Agile SDLC, support processes, automation opportunities, quality practices, and team productivity.
* Strong collaboration model with the TMS Manager and US teams to ensure global alignment, transparent communication, and consistent execution.

**Requirements**

* 8+ years of overall experience in application delivery, support, or technology leadership, preferably in Logistics, Supply Chain, Warehousing, Transportation, or related enterprise systems.
* 3+ years of experience leading Agile scrum execution, sprint delivery, support coordination, or technical-functional delivery teams.
* Strong understanding of enterprise application support, incident management, RCA, release management, testing practices, and operational metrics.
* Hands-on orientation with ability to understand application behavior, system integrations, data dependencies, domain workflows, and technical issues in depth.
* Good exposure to Agile practices, DevOps concepts, backlog management, sprint metrics, and continuous improvement methods.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, coordination, and influencing skills, especially while working with global business and technology teams.
* Ability to work independently, manage ambiguity, identify risks early, and drive actions to closure in collaboration with the TMS Manager.
* 4-year degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field preferred.
* Experience in Global Capability Centers / Captive IS organizations will be preferred.

**Measures of Success**

* Sprint commitments, delivery predictability, and quality outcomes consistently meet or exceed agreed targets.
* Support SLAs, incident communication, RCA completion, and follow-up actions are managed with discipline and transparency.
* Team members demonstrate stronger ownership, domain understanding, technical depth, and Agile maturity over time.
* US counterparts and business stakeholders have clear visibility into progress, risks, dependencies, and decisions needed.

title: Cloud Monitoring Administrator
description:
**ZS**
is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by
**bringing together data, science, technology**
and
**human ingenuity**
to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a
**client-first mentality**
to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS.
  
  
**What you'll do:**
**Cloud Monitoring Administrator**
in the
**Enterprise**
will…
  
  
We are hiring an Associate to administer our SolarWinds platform and monitor Windows, Linux, network and application infrastructure. You will build and tune monitoring, act first on alerts, and log in to servers to investigate and resolve issues before they affect users.
  
  
**SolarWinds administration**

* Install, configure, upgrade and maintain SolarWinds Orion / Hybrid Cloud Observability modules (NPM, SAM, SCM, NTA, NCM, WPM, Log Analyzer).
* Add and manage nodes, interfaces, volumes and application templates; discover new devices via Network Sonar.
* Create and tune alerts, thresholds, dependencies and escalation rules to reduce noise and false positives.
* Build custom dashboards, views and scheduled reports for operations and management.
* Manage polling engines, agents (agent-based and agentless), WMI/SNMP credentials and platform health.
* Perform routine maintenance: database cleanup, license tracking, certificate and service checks, backups.

**Infrastructure monitoring**

* Monitor Windows and Linux servers for CPU, memory, disk, services, processes and event logs.
* Monitor applications such as IIS, SQL Server, Apache/Tomcat, Active Directory, Exchange and custom services.
* Monitor network devices (routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, wireless controllers) for availability, interface utilization, bandwidth, errors and latency.
* Respond to alerts 24x7 in shifts, triage incidents, and escalate to L2/L3 or application teams with clear diagnostics.
* Onboard new servers and applications into monitoring as per the change process.

**Hands-on server work**

* Log in to Windows servers (RDP) and Linux servers (SSH) to validate alerts and perform first-level troubleshooting.
* Check and restart services, review logs, clear disk space, and verify connectivity (ping, traceroute, telnet, nslookup).
* Install and troubleshoot SolarWinds agents, SNMP and WMI configuration on servers.

**Process and documentation**

* Create and update tickets in ITSM tools (ServiceNow or Jira) within SLA.
* Maintain SOPs, runbooks and monitoring inventory; share shift handovers and daily health reports.
* Support audits, patching windows and maintenance mode scheduling.

**What you’ll bring:**

* 2–4 years of hands-on experience as a SolarWinds administrator.
* Knowledge of monitoring tools, such as Nagios, Zabbix, PRTG, SCOM, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Datadog, New Relic, Splunk or Grafana/Prometheus.
* Proven experience monitoring Windows servers, Linux servers, network devices (routers, switches, firewalls) and business applications.
* Hands-on server experience: has logged in to servers via RDP and SSH and performed basic tasks independently.
* Basic Windows Server administration: services, Event Viewer, Task Manager, disk management, IIS basics, user and permission checks.
* Basic Linux administration: common commands (top, df, du, free, ps, grep, systemctl, journalctl), file permissions and log navigation.
* Understanding of SNMP, WMI, ICMP and agent-based polling, plus networking basics (TCP/IP, DNS, ports, firewalls).
* Familiarity with ITIL incident, change and problem processes and an ITSM ticketing tool.
* Willingness to work in rotational shifts, including weekends when rostered.
* Fluency in English
* Client-first mentality
* Intense work ethic
* Collaborative spirit and problem-solving approach

**How you’ll grow:**

* Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathways
* Milestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunities
* Internal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions

**Perks & Benefits:**
At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. For details on total rewards in India, visit ZS India office locations | Where we work | ZS.
  
  
**Hybrid working model:**
We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. A flexible and connected ZS allows us to combine work from home and on-site presence at clients/ZS offices for the majority of our week. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face-to-face connections.
  
  
**Travel:**
Travel is a requirement at ZS for client facing ZSers; business needs of your project and client are the priority. While some projects may be local, all client-facing ZSers should be prepared to travel as needed. Travel provides opportunities to strengthen client relationships, gain diverse experiences, and enhance professional growth by working in different environments and cultures.
  
  
**Considering applying?**
At ZS, we honor the visible and invisible elements of our identities, personal experiences, and belief systems—the ones that comprise us as individuals, shape who we are, and make us unique. We believe your personal interests, identities, and desire to learn are integral to your success here. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. Learn more about our inclusion and belonging efforts and the networks ZS supports to assist our ZSers in cultivating community spaces and obtaining the resources they need to thrive.
  
  
If you’re eager to grow, contribute, and bring your unique self to our work, we encourage you to apply.

**Client & Stakeholder Management**

**Work Schedule & Coverage Requirements**

title: Security Remote Technical Support Firewall Engineer (L2)

**Your day at NTT DATA**
The Security Remote Technical Support Engineer (L2) is a developing engineering role, responsible for providing a professional remote technical support service to clients by identifying and resolving technical incidents and problems.
  
  
Through pre-emptive service incident and resolution activities, this role will restore service to clients by driving incidents to an effective resolution and ensuring all requests, process events and resolution incidents result in zero missed service level agreement (SLA) conditions.

title: Senior Analyst - Server Support
description:
The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring that Next’s Stores estate is fully patched with both Microsoft and 3rd party vendor updates and all vulnerabilities are remediated to maintain the security posture of next.
  
  
These take place in the servers’ planned maintenance window and all failures have to be troubleshooted and rescheduled. We need to ensure our device coverage is 100% so constant monitoring of our estate and comparing our coverage with other systems is essential.
  
  
**Responsibilities Will Also Include**
Managing and maintaining the Stores SCCM estate to ensure all Stores’ Distribution points are in a healthy state and content is up to date, SCCM software upgrades and proactively looking at ways to automate and improve the environment. Along with supporting areas with build issues at Stores.
  
  
Staging and deployment Store estate-wide of our in-house developed retail software via powershell.
  
  
**Job Title**
Senior Analyst - Server Support
  
  
**Job Description**
****Responsibilities:****

* Patch the Servers/Workstations with both Microsoft and third party updates and remediate Vulnerabilities.
* Implement streamlined processes to achieve 100% compliance and heavily promote and implement automated efficiencies.
* Monitor all troubleshooting and problem resolution on all aspects of SCCM and ensure that this is completed within SLA.
* Ensuring that complex and dynamic collections, advertisements, queries, reports are required and meet business objectives.
* All issues raised with SCCM client health are resolved in a timely manner.
* Monitoring of deployments in SCCM are on schedule and will be completed on time such as:

+ Creating and deploying applications.
+ Monitoring updates.
+ Reporting and remediation of the success or failure of Application.
+ Resolving all issues with deployments.

- SCCM Proactive monitoring ensuring all Store Distribution Point content is up to date and troubleshooting to fix any issues such as:

* Creating/Rebuilding DP'S.
* Troubleshoot client issues.
* Application updates, upgrades and distribution.
* Regular patching OS Wims for all task sequences.
* Improving build efficiency.
* Supporting Operations and Engineering Teams when build issues arise.
* Rapid remediation of any issues raised by Security Teams.
* Application and update deployment on Store Servers and POS devices through Deployment Scheduler/Manager.
* Deploy, Monitor and remediate apk’s on Hand held devices.
* Patching of Stores Android estate.
* Management of Compliance Settings.
* Manage clients using Group Policy.
* Experience managing and troubleshooting both Server and Client OS.
* Manage and report on hardware and software inventory.
* Create, modify, and produce custom reporting/dashboards as needed.
* Experience with Active Directory.
* Microsoft Failover Clustering.
* Able to create and develop and troubleshoot Powershell scripts.
* Create/maintain detailed technical and procedural documentation.
* Staging and deployment of in-house developed retail software via powershell.
* A team player who is hardworking and self-motivated and has the ability to mentor juniors.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
* Can work to strict deadlines, remain positive and calm under pressure.
* Experience working with change, request, problem and incident management.
* Provide line Management with clear and concise updates to significant issues, ensuring they are escalated when necessary.

**Desirable**

* Understanding and experience of working for a Retail company specifically for IT Server Support.
* Proven practical expertise on Firmware & Driver Upgrades.
* Log analysis through Agent Ransack
* Android deployment or management experience.
* Proven practical expertise on Certificate Management.
* Understanding and experience of working with PDQ Deploy tool.

**Essential**

* Proven track record in a Technical environment.
* Industry recognised qualifications such as MCP, MCSE, SCCM are advantageous.
* Technical Skills :
* Proven practical expertise with common server technologies such as Windows Servers & Active Directory, DNS, DHCP.
* Proven practical expertise on all aspects of SCCM including but not limited to Patching, OSD, Application packaging.
* Experience in Application deployment through Deployment Manager.
* Experience of deploying APKs through SureMDM Mobile Device Management.
* Previous Windows Server/Infrastructure experience in an operational environment.
* Proven practical expertise with Scripting – Powershell.
* Proven practical expertise on SQL Reporting Queries.
* Vulnerability Management - Qualys Preferrable.

Pune
  
  
,
  
  
India

Full time

title: CW Application Specialist
description:
**About Toll Group**
At Toll, we do more than just logistics - we move the businesses that move the world. Our 16,000 team members can help solve any logistics, transport, or supply chain challenge – big or small. We have been supporting our customers for more than 130 years. Today, we support more than 20,000 customers worldwide with 500 sites in 27 markets, and a forwarding network spanning 150 countries. We are proudly part of Japan Post — www.tollgroup.com
  
  
**As the CW1 Application Specialist, you will:**

* Lead in-country engagement for CW1 deployments and support additional deployments across new countries.
* Take an active role in the initial implementation, rollout, and ongoing upgrades of CW1 deployments within the region.
* Supplement existing CW1 knowledge by proactively understanding upcoming features, product enhancements, and business benefits.
* Maintain a highly effective support framework for the CW1 portfolio of applications.
* Provide responsive application support while ensuring delivery in accordance with agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Investigate and analyse deviations from agreed support service levels with offshore support providers.
* Perform proactive troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and implement preventative measures to minimize recurring incidents.
* Identify continuous improvement opportunities for application support and business processes to increase operational efficiency.
* Develop functional specifications for application enhancements, configuration changes, and business requirements.
* Safeguard the quality of transition from application build and deployment into production support.
* Work closely with Local Applications & Deployment teams, broader IT teams, business stakeholders, and offshore support providers to ensure agreed commitments are delivered.
* Share knowledge and proactively upskill offshore support providers with specialist CW1 module expertise.
* Review, enhance, and maintain support processes, documentation, and knowledge articles.
* Leverage and enhance technical support tools to improve service quality and operational efficiency.
* Continuously develop expertise in the CW1 application portfolio, including country-specific configurations and core modules such as Air & Sea, Customs, Customer Service, Sales, Finance, and Warehouse Management.

**About you to be successful in this role, you will need:**

* At least 5 years' experience working with CW1 (or similar freight forwarding enterprise application suites).
* At least 5 years' experience working within freight forwarding and logistics organizations.
* Wisetech Global Certifications (CCO, CCS, CCP) are a Prerequisite.
* Demonstrated knowledge of SQL Query Writing.
* Working knowledge of PAVE workflow configuration & setup is favourable.
* At least 5 years' experience providing IT application support in a multinational enterprise environment.
* Strong knowledge of freight forwarding operational processes and CW1 business workflows.
* Demonstrated experience supporting global IT environments comprising both onshore and offshore support teams.
* Experience in CW1 implementations, deployments, upgrades, and production support.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis skills.
* Experience preparing functional specifications for application enhancements and changes.
* Excellent customer service orientation with the ability to manage and meet SLA commitments.
* Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills in English.
* Strong stakeholder management, collaboration, and knowledge-sharing abilities.
* A proactive mindset with a passion for continuous improvement, operational excellence, and delivering high-quality application support.

**What moves you?**
At Toll, you can help play a vital role in delivering what matters. From food, fuel, medicine and rescue services, we keep businesses and communities thriving. Every day brings change. We see that as an opportunity. To be curious. To ask the right questions. And build meaningful connections. Because finding new ways to solve problems is what we do. With a bold vision to expand our global reach, our 16,000+ people bring a passion for progress. We collaborate in friendly, caring teams, supported by approachable leaders who give us the autonomy to quickly make decisions with impact. Learn and grow with industry-leading training, alongside talented experts. Feel empowered to take on diverse challenges and new responsibilities to move you, our customers, and our world further.
  
  
Are you excited about this role but are concerned you don’t meet all the requirements? If you have similar skills and are willing to learn then we encourage you to apply anyway. We know that some people hesitate to apply for jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Toll, we value a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re interested in this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly then please talk to us – you may be just the right candidate for this or other roles we have coming up.
  
  
At Toll everyone is welcome including those of all ages, ethnicities, genders and abilities.
  
  
To find out more about us visit www.careers.tollgroup.com
  
  
You must be entitled to work in India and be prepared to undertake pre-employment checks including a criminal history check and medical.

title: Advanced Services Engineer
description:
**Description**
**Shape the Future of Cybersecurity at Forescout**
Every day cyberattacks threaten to disrupt hospitals, power grids, financial systems, and the infrastructure we all depend on. At Forescout, we build defenses that keep civilization running smoothly in an increasingly connected world.
  
  
For more than 25 years, Fortune 100 organizations, government agencies, and large enterprises have trusted Forescout as their foundation to manage cyber risk, ensure compliance, and mitigate threats. From power grids and healthcare systems to financial networks and transportation hubs, Forescout protects the critical infrastructure of our modern world.
  
  
**What Will You Do**
At Forescout, we seek customer driven individuals who thrive on collaboration, embrace innovation, and are passionate about delivering exceptional customer experiences. Working as one team, we anticipate emerging threats and create forward-thinking solutions that shape the future of cybersecurity. Join us and make a meaningful impact through your unique talents and perspective.
  
  
The Advanced Services Engineer (ASE) position at Forescout Technologies offers the opportunity to assist customers with technical issues to ensure optimal performance of our products and solutions within large and complex customer environments. You will need a solid understanding of Forescout products and basic knowledge of the environments in which they are deployed. You will take ownership of assigned projects and support configurations to address and resolve customer issues. Competencies essential to your success in this role include customer service, problem-solving, organization, time management, combined with agility of learning and technical aptitude, and operating Forescout solutions in real-world customer environments. The ASE will troubleshoot the Forescout solutions, provide upgrade and deployment best practices to the base Forescout Solution, as well as integrate the Forescout product with other customer third-party software, such as remote access and SIEM technologies.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Develop a deep understanding of Forescout products and in-depth knowledge of environments in which they are deployed.
* Provide complex product support, in a collaborative team environment, to customers, other Forescout employees, and partners.
* Participate in knowledge transfer with teammates, attend formal team training sessions, brown bags, and formal mentoring.
* Routinely monitor and develop knowledge assets to enable customer self-sufficiency.
* Monitor and manage Support Services cases.
* Achieve a high level of expertise in all areas of the product.
* Capable of completing assigned duties, handling cases, and escalations within guidelines with minimal direction from Support Services Leadership.
* Routinely act independently while researching and developing solutions to customer issues.
* Liaison to Engineering on product issues, including design, features, and defects.
* Acts as a technical point of contact and is repeatedly sought by others to provide specialty knowledge to assist them in their problem-solving.
* Administer and mature a customer enterprise deployment of the Forescout solution.
* Interface with Forescout Support and/or R&D to resolve issues that may impede success.
* Analyse and optimize polices in accordance with customers’ business requirements.
* Manage equipment installation and configuration at all locations, to include lab environments.
* Assist customers with planning and executing Forescout software and hardware upgrades.
* Create customer reports to achieve project alignment and unity of effort.

**What You Will Bring To Forescout**

* Computer Networking Systems Administrator level knowledge of all protocol layers
* Strong knowledge of enterprise networking environments
* Expertise in debugging and root-cause analysis in complex systems and large environments
* Understanding of enterprise computing environments, distributed applications, and strong knowledge and understanding of TCP/IP networks to include ASA, Palo Alto firewalls, Cisco, Juniper, and Brocade switches.
* Experience with the configuration of Forescout products.
* Hands-on experience in both Windows and Linux, Mac OSX platforms, with a solid understanding of networking principles and security best practices
* Computer Networking Systems Administrator level knowledge of all protocol layers
* Strong knowledge of enterprise networking environments
* Industry Certifications such as CASP+, Security+, CEH, CCNA, SANS (GCIA, GCIH, GREM, GPEN) is a plus.
* Advanced Administrator’s level of understanding of Operating Systems (Linux, Windows, Macintosh, and UNIX) is a plus.
* Experience installing, implementing, and debugging network access control security solutions is a plus.
* Desired skills: VMware -vSphere, Microsoft Hyper-V, and PGSQL
* Understanding of programming languages: C, Java, Bash, and Python is a plus
* Minimum 3 years of experience with network hardware configuration.
* 3 years of significant experience with Windows-based operating systems and Unix systems, specifically Linux.
* Expertise in deploying large-scale enterprise deployments/data centers.
* Experience deploying and/or supporting enterprise security software products such as firewalls, IPS, Anti-Virus solutions, application firewalls, high availability solutions, network management systems, and virtual systems.
* Experience implementing complicated software products that involve multiple components.
* Experience in working and troubleshooting in heterogeneous environments.
* Ability to clearly document complicated steps and procedures.
* Working knowledge of shell, Perl, and XML scripting.
