Ensure friendly, professional customer interactions throughout the service lifecycle.
  
  
Act as the main point of contact for technical issues, collaborating directly with Development and QA teams.
  
  
Thrive in a challenging and dynamic environment, delivering world-class support and technical solutions.
  
  
Qualifications:
  
  
5+ years of technical support experience.
  
  
Experience in Vulnerability Management and Web Application Security/Firewall application support.
  
  
In-depth TCP/IP understanding and LAN/WAN infrastructure knowledge.
  
  
Strong foundation in Windows and/or solid Linux/Unix experience in an enterprise environment.
  
  
Familiarity with common OS services (IIS, BIND, Apache, AD, WINS, Samba, SSH).
  
  
Knowledge of firewalls, Intrusion Detection System technologies, and Network Vulnerability Scanners.
  
  
Outstanding troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  
  
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  
  
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
  
  
Networking:
  
  
OSI Layer understanding.
  
  
Knowledge of broadcast domain vs. collision domain.
  
  
Familiarity with different records zones in DNS and how it works.
  
  
Understanding of SSL Handshake and TCP/IP Handshake.
  
  
Proficiency in ARP, DHCP, proxy servers, and DNS cache clearing.
  
  
Differentiation between TCP and UDP, and protocols & their workings.
  
  
Linux/Unix:
  
  
Understanding of the boot process and run levels.
  
  
Various ways to assign an IP address to a Unix/Linux/Debian machine.
  
  
Proficient in checking running processes, hidden files, and installing packages.
  
  
Knowledge of sudo, permissions, file systems, and SSH banner.
  
  
Windows:
  
  
Insight into the Windows boot process and control panel basics.
  
  
Understanding of UAC, registry hives, and remote registry manipulation tools.
  
  
Knowledge of kernel mode vs. user mode, Active Directory, and Group Policies.
  
  
Familiarity with Kerberos and NTLM authentication, Procmon, and the service control manager.
  
  
Security:
  
  
Understanding of vulnerabilities, the vulnerability cycle, and exploits.
  
  
Knowledge of malware types (virus, trojan, worm) and False/True Positive/Negative concepts.
  
  
Understanding of False Positive, False Negative, True Positive, and True Negative in the security context.

Experience with Kubernetes, containers, Cloud services, packet capture review, and diagnosis.
  
  
Previous API support and Regex knowledge.
  
  
Scripting experience (Bash, Python).
  
  
Knowledge of major web server software, UNIX/Windows web services, and diverse platforms.
  
  
Oracle and Microsoft SQL knowledge.
  
  
CCNA, MCSE, CISSP, CompTIA Security+, and CEH certifications are highly desirable.
  
  
Experience with Customer Support and Development Tools (Salesforce, Jira, etc.).
  
  
Willing to work in 24/7 rotational shifts.

title: Senior Technical Support Engineer
description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.
  
  
So, what’s the role all about?
  
  
NiCE is building SPARK, a new internal incubation team that turns great ideas from across CX International into working AI solutions, and then into enterprise-grade tools that roll out to colleagues around the world. Every tool we launch needs a great front door, and that is the Support Helpdesk.
  
  
As Support Helpdesk in the SPARK team, you will be the first point of contact for colleagues using the AI tools SPARK builds: answering questions, triaging issues, fixing what you can, and escalating what you cannot, with clear evidence. You are an advanced software engineer at heart, so you can go beyond scripts and FAQs: read logs, test an API call, spot a configuration or prompt problem, and explain it in simple terms.
  
  
You will be the primary helpdesk owner, supported by a backup or rotating colleague for cover, and you will partner closely with the AI Architects & Builders and the Change Management & Evangelist. What you learn from users will shape what SPARK builds and improves next.
  
  
How will you make an impact?
  
  
You will own the user support experience for SPARK solutions, keeping colleagues productive and feeding what you learn back into the tools.
  
  
Support Our Users
  
  

* Be the first point of contact for user questions, access requests, and issues, through the team’s support channels
* Triage, prioritise, and track every request through to resolution in the ticketing system, with clear and timely updates to users
* Troubleshoot technical issues by reviewing logs, testing API calls, checking configurations and prompts, reproducing problems, and fixing what is within your reachEscalate to the AI Architects & Builders with clear reproduction steps, evidence, and impact, so engineers can act fast

Build Knowledge
  
  

* Create and maintain FAQs, how-to guides, and a searchable knowledge base for every SPARK solution
* Document known issues, workarounds, and runbooks, and keep them current as solutions change
* Help onboard new users and groups, working with the Change Management & Evangelist on guides and training materials

Spot Patterns and Improve
  
  

* Analyse ticket trends to identify recurring issues, usability gaps, and training needs, and report them to the Change Management & Evangelist and the AI Architects & Builders
* Track support metrics such as volume, response and resolution times, user satisfaction, and top issues, and share regular summaries
* Capture user feedback and feature requests for the product backlog
* Create real time dashboard for requestor to have visibility into progress

Automate and Cover
  
  

* Use scripts and AI tools to automate repetitive support tasks such as triage, routing, FAQ answers, and reporting
* Coordinate with your backup or rotating support colleague to maintain coverage during absences and busy periods
* Help monitor usage and platform health, and raise alerts on anything that looks wrong

Have you got what it takes?
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* 4-8 years of experience as a software engineer, or in L2/L3 application or technical support for software products
* Hands-on technical skills: scripting or programming (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar), SQL, REST APIs, tools such as Postman, and reading application logs
* Experience with ticketing and service management tools such as ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, or similar
* Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills, and the patience to guide non-technical users clearly
* Excellent written communication: clear, friendly, and concise answers and documentation
* Everyday use of generative AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or Copilot, and an understanding of how AI answers can go wrong
* An ownership mindset: you stay with an issue until it is resolved or handed over cleanly
* Fluency in English
* Ability to work support hours that cover the regions the team serves (working pattern to be confirmed)

You will have an advantage if you also have:
  
  

* Experience supporting internal AI tools, chatbots, or agent platforms
* Experience building automations or lightweight bots for support
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Azure, and with basic CI/CD
* Experience with knowledge base tools and writing technical documentation
* Background in CX, contact centre, CCaaS, or enterprise SaaS support
* Experience supporting users across multiple time zones

What’s in it for you?
  
  
SPARK is a chance to be a founding member of a brand-new team, and to shape how NiCE turns AI ideas into everyday tools used by colleagues around the world.
  
  
Join an ever-growing, market-disrupting, global company where the teams, comprised of the best of the best, work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate about AI, innovative at heart, and excited to constantly raise the bar on what intelligent technology can do, you may just be our next NiCEr!
  
  
Enjoy NiCE-FLEX!
  
  
At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.
  
  
**Req ID:**
11868
  
  
**Reporting into:**
Tech Manager, Engineering, CX
  
  
**Role Type:**
Individual Contributor
  
  
**About NiCE**
*NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions.*
*Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30+ countries.*
*NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.*

title: Associate Systems Support Engineer
description:

**Associate Systems Support Engineer**
to join our IT operations team. The successful candidate will be responsible for monitoring and maintaining the performance of critical systems, ensuring the uptime and availability of applications and infrastructure. This role involves working with monitoring tools such as AppDynamics (AppD), LogicMonitor, and Azure Monitor, as well as monitoring SQL databases, Windows servers, and Internet Information Services (IIS). The Associate Systems Support Engineer will provide L1 and L2 support while ensuring compliance with service level agreements (SLAs).
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Monitor the performance and availability of applications and infrastructure using tools such as AppDynamics, LogicMonitor, and Azure Monitor.
* Conduct regular health checks and performance tuning of SQL databases to ensure optimal operation.
* Oversee the functionality and performance of Windows servers and IIS, applying necessary configurations and updates as needed.
* Monitor interface subsystems to ensure seamless data flow and connectivity between systems.
* Provide first-level support for system incidents, diagnosing issues and escalating problems to higher-level engineering teams when necessary.
* Maintain documentation related to system configurations, procedures, and incident responses.
* Participate in root cause analysis (RCA) for incidents to prevent future occurrences and improve system reliability.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement system upgrades, patches, and configurations while minimizing downtime.
* Ensure 24/7 uptime of critical systems, responding quickly to alerts and incidents to meet predefined SLAs.
* Stay updated with industry trends and best practices to recommend improvements to monitoring processes and tools.

**Key Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
* 1-3 years of experience in a systems monitoring and support role.
* Familiarity with application performance monitoring tools such as AppDynamics, LogicMonitor, and Azure Monitor.
* Basic knowledge of SQL databases, including monitoring and troubleshooting techniques.
* Understanding of Windows Server administration and IIS management.
* Experience with monitoring server uptime, performance metrics, and alert management.
* Proficient in troubleshooting system issues and performing root cause analysis.
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail to ensure high-quality service delivery.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
* Availability to work in a 24x7 environment (9 Hours or 12 Hours shift), including evenings, weekends, and on-call rotations as required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Understanding of monitoring tools like AppDynamics and LogicMonitor.
* Understanding of healthcare application is an added advantage.
* Knowledge of ITIL best practices and frameworks.

We are at our best when problems seem the hardest, pushing to identify root causes and solutions. We are a combination of passion and persistence. If you recently graduated or if you are in the last year of your study and are looking for a job to kick start your career in the Mendix Community, then Mendix is for you.

* Investigate mid-complexity reported issues, reproduce, troubleshoot and determine the most efficient way to identify the root cause within our platform infrastructure and software.
* and manage cross-functional coordination with these teams. We advocate quick solutions and root cause analysis to improve the customer experience.
* Work with minimal supervision on mid-complexity issues that require the ability to make independent decisions and discretion. Coordinate within a large organization to navigate product and project leads to determine how your problem should be communicated.

* Work with your product team to enable new features before deploying to existing customers. The focus is on how to support the new features.

* Love to engage with customers to solve any challenges they might face.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in information systems, engineering, computer science, or equivalent.
* 2 to 4 years of experience as technical support or technical consultant for customers.
* You possess excellent communication skills, both written and verbal English.
* You are well-organized, flexible and can keep an overview of all your tasks. You are able to manage and prioritise daily tasks based on business impact, maintaining focus on service level agreements and following through on escalated items with the associated Customer and Product teams.
* A curious and inquisitive mind, willingness to learn, and ability to fail fast to keep progress moving forward. Self-directed and able to use online training and documentation to learn about existing software features and develop new guidelines for others on the team.
* Passion for technology and have strong problem solving and analytical skills.
* Ability related to the cloud industry, such as data storage, analytics, and application development.
* Understanding of cloud concepts, ability to read and analyse logs/graphs and other cloud metrics, experience with logging and monitoring tools, networking commands, etc.
* Relevant work experience in programming languages, basic application development, integration methodologies, communications and IT networking, relational databases, and/or public Cloud technologies (eg. AWS, Azure).
* ITIL knowledge, Incident management, Problem Management, Service requests and experience with ticketing tools.
* A developed approach to troubleshooting customer and technical issues – not only following pre-defined checklists but helping drive the process for technical issues never before encountered.

**We are Siemens**
A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow! We offer a comprehensive reward package which includes a competitive basic salary, bonus scheme, generous holiday allowance, pension, and private healthcare.

title: Escalation Manager
description:
**Organization Overview**
**Company Description**
QAD Inc. is a leading provider of adaptive, cloud-based enterprise software and services for global manufacturing companies. Global manufacturers face ever-increasing disruption caused by technology-driven innovation and changing consumer preferences. In order to survive and thrive, manufacturers must be able to innovate and change business models at unprecedented rates of speed. QAD calls these companies Adaptive Manufacturing Enterprises. QAD solutions help customers in the automotive, life sciences, packaging, consumer products, food and beverage, high tech and industrial manufacturing industries rapidly adapt to change and innovate for competitive advantage. We are looking for talented individuals who want to join us on our mission to help solve relevant real-world problems in manufacturing and the supply chain.
  
  
**This hybrid position requires candidates to be based in Pune, with 3-4 days of in-office collaboration per week.**
**Job Description**
The
**Escalation Manager**
is a specialized individual contributor role within the Global Support organization, responsible for owning and managing critical customer account escalations from onset through stabilization and closure. This role acts as the single point of accountability within Support for escalated accounts, ensuring issues are addressed with urgency, structure, and cross-functional alignment.
  
  
The EM’s primary objective is to stabilize high-risk customer accounts by driving the resolution of critical issues, coordinating closely with Support, Engineering, Cloud Operations, and Product teams. This includes ensuring proper prioritization of P1 and high-impact cases, enforcing case hygiene, facilitating timely Engineering engagement, and ensuring that internal escalation paths are triggered proactively before the customer or Sales team raises concerns externally.
  
  
This role requires strong technical depth across ERP application architecture, infrastructure, and troubleshooting. The EM must be able to understand complex technical landscapes, challenge and guide resolution strategies, and hold teams accountable for progress. While not responsible for direct implementation or relationship management, the EM acts as the technical escalation leader for the account, ensuring a coordinated and transparent support response.
  
  
**Beyond day-to-day escalation handling, the Escalation Manager plays a critical role in:**

* Identifying systemic or recurring issues contributing to account instability.
* Driving and participating in account-level stabilization plans.
* Engaging in post-escalation reviews to strengthen processes and prevent recurrence.
* Ensuring clear and structured internal and external communication.

This is a high-visibility role requiring composure under pressure, strong cross-functional leadership without formal authority, and the ability to influence outcomes across multiple teams. Given the nature of escalated accounts, the position may require flexible working hours, on-call participation, and direct executive visibility.
  
  
**Escalated Account Ownership**

* Act as the primary escalation lead for high-impact customer accounts, ensuring structured management of escalations from initiation through stabilization and closure.
* Drive internal alignment and ensure timely execution of action plans across Support, Engineering, Cloud Ops, and Product.

**Stabilization And Resolution Strategy**

* Develop and execute account-level stabilization plans to address critical issues, reduce ticket volumes, and restore customer confidence.
* Proactively identify systemic issues contributing to escalations and drive resolution with the right internal stakeholders.

**Escalation Governance**

* Ensure proper prioritization, case hygiene, and timely engagement of technical resources for all escalated accounts.
* Trigger and manage internal escalation paths proactively to avoid external escalations through CSM or Sales.
* Set customer expectations and provide updates regarding troubleshooting and resolution action plans for internal and customer-facing communications.

**Technical Engagement And Resolution Acceleration**

* Leverage strong technical knowledge of ERP architecture and infrastructure to guide resolution strategies and validate progress.
* Collaborate closely with Critical Support team, Tier 2/3 engineers, SMEs, and product teams to remove technical blockers and accelerate resolution timelines.

**Cross-Functional Coordination And Communication**

* Coordinate across Support, Engineering, Cloud Ops, Product Management, and CSM/CSDM teams to ensure alignment and accountability.
* Deliver clear, structured, and timely communications on escalation status, risks, and next steps to all stakeholders.

**Feedback Loop And Product Improvement**

* Partner with CSM/CSDMs and Product Management to share customer feedback, recurring pain points, and systemic issues observed during escalations.
* Work with Engineering teams to help prioritize critical fixes and influence product stability and supportability improvements.

**Shift Coverage And Flexibility**

* Participate in shift rotations, weekend shifts, and on-call coverage to provide uninterrupted global support.
* Adapt to varying scheduling requirements to ensure timely assistance for customers in different time zones.

**Continuous Improvement And Post-Escalation Review**

* Lead or contribute to post-escalation reviews to identify root causes, process gaps, and product opportunities.
* Support implementation of preventive measures to minimize future escalations and strengthen overall support readiness.
* Collaborate with people managers and business leaders to drive continuous improvement in people, processes, and technology through a closed-loop process by identifying drivers for escalation.

**Qualifications**
**Education:**
A Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. Equivalent experience will be considered.
  
  
**Experience**

* 5+ years of experience in enterprise product support, technical escalation management, or critical response roles in a SaaS or ERP environment.
* Demonstrated ability to own and drive critical account escalations, ensuring cross-functional alignment and rapid resolution.
* Proven experience in working closely with Engineering, Product Management, and Customer Success teams to resolve high-impact technical issues.
* Strong background in ERP systems (such as QAD, SAP, Oracle ERP, or Dynamics 365) with the ability to understand complex technical landscapes and influence resolution strategies.
* Experience coordinating multiple high-priority issues simultaneously under pressure, with clear accountability and customer focus.
* Experience leveraging AI tools (such as generative AI assistants, diagnostic copilots, or predictive analytics platforms) to analyze incident data, perform rapid root cause analysis, and identify systemic escalation patterns across ticket histories.
* Hands-on experience using Jira Service Management and Salesforce Service Cloud to manage critical account escalations, track ticket SLA compliance, enforce case hygiene, and link Tier-3 engineering bugs with customer-facing cases.
* Background operating within multi-tenant SaaS or hybrid-cloud environments (AWS/Azure/GCP), managing incident workflows involving cloud infrastructure, microservices, database performance, or server deployment issues.
* Proven track record of driving rapid war-room coordination, real-time stakeholder updates, and post-incident documentation.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong understanding of enterprise ERP architecture, system integrations, and infrastructure components.
* Mastery of Google Workspace (Google Docs, Sheets, Slides) for building real-time escalation trackers, publishing root cause analysis (RCA) reports, and delivering executive-ready presentations.
* Cloud Infrastructure & Architecture: Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud), including cloud infrastructure components, APIs, microservices, containerized environments, and log management tools (e.g., Datadog, Splunk, CloudWatch).
* Ability to understand and validate technical resolution paths proposed by Support, Engineering, or Cloud Ops teams.
* Familiarity with incident and escalation management frameworks and best practices in SaaS or on-prem environments.
* Preferred / Bonus Qualifications: Prompt Engineering & Generative AI Tools: Hands-on experience utilizing Generative AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, MS Copilot, or custom internal LLMs) for prompt-driven summary generation, ticket sentiment analysis, incident documentation, and automated stakeholder communication drafting.
* QAD PKS or relevant industry certifications are a plus.

**Additional Information**

* Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work-life balance.
* Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.
* Collaborative culture of smart and hard-working people who support one another to get the job done.
* An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea-sharing is always prioritized over level or Hierarchy.
* Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set

**About QAD**
QAD | Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars — Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) — QAD | Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days.
  
  
QAD is committed to ensuring that every employee feels they work in an environment that values their contributions, respects their unique perspectives and provides opportunities for growth regardless of background. QAD’s DEI program is driving higher levels of diversity, equity and inclusion so that employees can bring their whole self to work.
  
  
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

title: IT Technical Analyst - Senior (WMS)
description:
****Job Summary:****
Provides application or infrastructure technical expertise, analysis and specifications for IT systems to meet business requirements in accordance with IT architecture policies and standards; translate requirements into technical specifications, create detailed solution design, coordinate construction, installation, configuration and testing of IT systems; and identifies, troubleshoots and resolves system technical issues.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities:****
Assists in creating and managing the technical specifications from which programs and configurations will be applied to create the application, infrastructure or complete solution. Assists in technical analysis of potential solutions including evaluating the technical fit and viability of commercial-of-the-shelf products versus custom built solution. Delivers solution design, adhering to standards and leveraging re-use of components. Assists in creating high level and detail design of infrastructure OR applications, interfaces, conversions, extensions, reports, and workflows while meeting architecture, security, performance, scalability, and maintainability requirements. Assists technical and infrastructure groups in understanding the solution design and specifications. Works closely with IT technical service providers to ensure outsourced work packages are delivered to specifications, meeting key parameters of quality, schedule, cost, security, performance, and scalability. Participates in formal design reviews and code reviews (where applicable) to ensure the detailed design specifications have been understood and coding standards have been adhered to by the development team(s). Leverages re-usability of component designs to reduce costs and shorten time to deliver solution Ensures adherence to obtain efficiency in the build and deploy processes, leveraging automation where possible. Assists in the test strategy and execution of master test plan. Participates in the creation of standards, processes, procedures, and guidelines for the IT design and development community as well work instructions or ‘runbooks’ used for end-user support. Analyzes and revises existing systems and documentation to identify remediation or improvements in the application or infrastructure solution. Provides level 3 support for critical issues.
  
  
****Competencies:****
Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.
  
  
Global perspective - Taking a broad view when approaching issues, using a global lens.
  
  
Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
  
  
Manages conflict - Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise.
  
  
Optimizes work processes - Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.
  
  
Data Modeling - Creates, writes and tests data models, test scripts and build scripts using industry standards and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.
  
  
Performance Tuning - Conceptualizes, analyzes and solves application, database and hardware problems using industry standards and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.
  
  
Solution Configuration - Configures, creates and tests a solution for commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) applications using industry standards and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.
  
  
Solution Design - Creates and defines the solution design complete with instrumentation and measurement, using industry standards and tools, version control, and build and test automation to synthesize diagrams, models and documentation in order to build a solution that meets buildability, business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.
  
  
Solution Functional Fit Analysis - Composes and decomposes a system into its component parts using procedures, tools and work aides for the purpose of studying how well the component parts were designed, purchased and configured to interact holistically to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.
  
  
Solution Modeling - Creates, designs and formulates models, diagrams and documentation using industry standards, tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.
  
  
Solution Validation Testing - Validates a configuration item change or solution using the Function's defined best practices, including the Systems Development Life Cycle (SDLC) standards, tools and metrics, to ensure that it works as designed and meets customer requirements.
  
  
Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
  
  
****Education, Licenses, Certifications:****
College, university, or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or related subject, or relevant equivalent experience required. This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.
  
  
****Experience:****
Intermediate level of relevant work experience required. 3-5 years of experience.

title: Sr. Demo Engineer
description:
Role Summary

We are seeking a
**Senior Demo Engineer**
to join our global Demo Engineering team, serving as the lead escalation point for technical operations and demo environment tickets within the EMEA region. In this role, you will ensure the reliability, performance, and availability of demo environments used daily by Sales Engineers and field teams.

You will bring strong SaaS technical support experience alongside solid knowledge of cloud infrastructure, specifically
**AWS EC2**
and
**AWS Systems Manager (SSM)**
. You will be responsible for diagnosing complex issues, streamlining ticket escalations, maintaining system health, and enhancing demo platform automation.

Key Responsibilities
  
  
Regional Escalation & Technical Support

* Serve as the primary senior technical contact and escalation point for all EMEA demo environment issues and support tickets.
* Perform deep technical triage, root-cause analysis, and rapid remediation for environment failures, configuration drift, and service interruptions.
* Partner closely with regional Sales Engineers (SEs) to provide timely ticket updates, operational guidance, and resolution SLAs.

Cloud Infrastructure & Systems Operations

* Manage, configure, and maintain virtual server infrastructure hosting demo environments primarily built on
  **AWS EC2**
  .
* Use
  **AWS Systems Manager (SSM)**
  for patch management, remote execution, parameter storage, and system maintenance across regional fleet instances.
* Monitor service health, application availability, and performance metrics to proactively prevent environment downtime.

SaaS Environment Maintenance & Quality Assurance

* Oversee SaaS tenant configurations, API integration points, and identity provider setups required for live SE demonstrations.
* Maintain consistency and baseline stability across regional tenant environments.

Automation & Process Improvement

* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive support tasks, environment provisioning, and health checks.
* Develop and maintain automated test scripts and orchestration playbooks to improve platform stability and setup efficiency.

Qualifications & Requirements
  
  

* **Experience:**
  5+ years of technical support, systems engineering, or demo engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise software environments.
* **AWS Core Knowledge:**
  Deep working experience with
  **AWS EC2**
  instance management, networking basics (VPCs, Security Groups), and AMI maintenance.
* **Systems Administration:**
  Strong expertise in
  **AWS Systems Manager (SSM)**
  for fleet management, maintenance windows, and automation runbooks.
* **SaaS Support Mastery:**
  Proven track record in Tier 2/3 technical support, troubleshooting web applications, APIs, authentication mechanisms, and browser/client-side integrations.
* **Problem-Solving & Escalation Ownership:**
  Ability to independently manage high-priority technical escalations under tight deadlines while maintaining clear communication.
* **Communication:**
  Excellent verbal and written English communication skills to support cross-functional stakeholders across the EMEA region.

Preferred / Bonus Skills
  
  

* **Multi-Cloud Agent Platform Management:**
  Experience building, deploying, or managing AI agents using platform-native services such as
  **Amazon Bedrock Agents**
  ,
  **Google Cloud Vertex AI Agent Builder**
  (Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform), and
  **Azure AI Foundry**
  /
  **Microsoft Copilot Studio**
  .
* **Test & Task Automation:**
  Hands-on experience with end-to-end browser automation tools (e.g.,
  **Playwright**
  , Selenium, or Cypress).
* **Configuration Management:**
  Experience with infrastructure-as-code or automation frameworks such as
  **Ansible**
  ,
  **Chef**
  , Puppet, or Terraform.
* **Scripting:**
  Proficiency in Python, Bash, or PowerShell for operational automation.
* **Domain Experience:**
  Knowledge of Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), IAM, or enterprise security architectures.

What Success Looks Like in 90 Days
  
  

* **First 30 Days:**
  Complete onboarding on the Demo Engineering architecture, gain access to core AWS environments, and shadow regional ticket workflows.
* **First 60 Days:**
  Take primary ownership of EMEA escalation tickets, managing triage through resolution while maintaining baseline SLA targets.
* **First 90 Days:**
  Identify key friction points in EMEA environment reliability and deliver at least one automation or tooling improvement.

description:

NA

Summary:
  
  
As an Operations Engineer, a typical day involves overseeing the smooth functioning of production systems and services, ensuring they meet operational requirements and service agreements. This role requires continuous monitoring, managing incident responses, and coordinating with various teams to maintain system reliability and performance. The position demands proactive identification of potential issues and efficient handling of service delivery to support business continuity and operational excellence.
  
  
Job Title: Amazon EKS SME
  
  
**Job Description-**
We are looking for a Senior Amazon EKS SME to support and enhance our enterprise Kubernetes platform on AWS. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in EKS, Kubernetes administration, cloud-native technologies, automation, and production support.In addition to performing regular support duties, the Shift Lead will oversee service level adherence, maintain team accountability, and serve as the primary point of contact for the team during critical situations.
  
  
Key Responsibilities-
  
  
Manage and support Amazon EKS clusters across Production and Non-Production environments.
  
  
Perform cluster upgrades, patching, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management.
  
  
Lead L3/L4 support, incident resolution, and root cause analysis.
  
  
Drive infrastructure automation using Terraform, GitHub, Jenkins, and scripting.
  
  
Design, deploy, manage, and optimize Amazon EKS clusters across Production and Non-Production environments.
  
  
Perform cluster provisioning, upgrades, patching, configuration management, and lifecycle management.
  
  
Manage node groups, autoscaling, capacity planning, and cluster performance optimization.
  
  
Troubleshoot complex Kubernetes issues involving networking, storage, DNS, ingress, and application deployments.
  
  
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate cloud solutions with existing systems.
  
  
Provide support and guidance to team members.
  
  
Handle escalations promptly and effectively.
  
  
Perform regular maintenance and updates to prevent downtime.
  
  
Create and maintain technical documentation and guides.
  
  
Analyze system performance and implement improvements.
  
  
Maintain high-quality standards in all operations.
  
  
Technical Experience-
  
  
Strong work experience on public cloud services mainly on Amazon EKS and Kubernetes along with ECS, EC2, VPC, IAM, EFS, EBS, ALB/NLB, Route53, CloudWatch
  
  
Networking, scaling, messaging, and other IaaS and basic idea of PaaS Services.
  
  
Any one Cloud Certification would be preferred like AWS Sysops Admin, AWS Cloud Architect – Associate/Professional
  
  
Possess good knowledge on CI/CD tools like GitHub and Jenkins.
  
  
Should have hands-on experience in Windows / Linux server basic administration.
  
  
Good hand-on with Terraform/Ansible.
  
  
Linux Administration and Shell/Python scripting
  
  
Experience in troubleshooting complex containerized workloads
  
  
Good to have knowledge in Azure Cloud.
  
  
Professional Attributes-
  
  
Good verbal and written communication skills to connect with customers at varying levels of the organization.
  
  
Ability to operate independently and make decisions with little direct supervision.
  
  
Shift Details:
  
  

* Flexible to work in 24/7 shift.
* RTO- 3 days office presence

Additional Information:
  
  

* The candidate should have minimum 7.5 years of experience in Kubernetes.
* This position is based at our Pune office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

title: Sr Lead, Infra End User Computing
description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
Position : Sr Lead, Infra EUC
  
  
The Sr.Lead Engineer, End User Computing is a senior technical role responsible for designing, implementing and continuously improving secure, resilient and user-centered endpoint services. The role supports Windows, macOS, mobile, browser, application-delivery and virtual workspace capabilities across a global, regulated enterprise. It combines hands-on engineering with architecture, automation, security, governance, documentation and technical leadership.
  
  
The engineer will support the current hybrid environment while advancing the EUC roadmap toward Intune-centered governance, cloud-managed provisioning and servicing, modern application delivery, intelligent automation, unified reporting, stronger lifecycle controls and reduced reliance on legacy infrastructure and scripting.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and implement enterprise endpoint solutions across Windows, macOS, iOS, Android, Cloud PC, virtual workspaces and supported device-ownership models.
* Engineer and maintain Microsoft Intune, Configuration Manager/SCCM, Windows Autopilot, Windows Autopatch, Windows Update for Business, Jamf, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Group Policy and related services.
* Define target-state architectures, configuration baselines, deployment patterns, technical standards, test criteria, support models and operational acceptance requirements.
* Lead device provisioning, enrollment, configuration, patching, operating-system upgrades, driver and firmware servicing, recovery, retirement and lifecycle cleanup.
* Develop deployment-ring strategies, controlled pilots, success criteria, rollback plans, exception processes and evidence requirements for enterprise changes.
* Translate security, risk, audit and regulatory requirements into enforceable endpoint controls, monitoring, remediation and audit-ready evidence.
* Engineer capabilities supporting device compliance, encryption, least privilege, endpoint hardening, certificates, trust stores, application control, secure administration and vulnerability remediation.
* Develop secure and supportable automation using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, REST APIs, proactive remediations and approved workflow tools.
* Replace fragile or legacy scripts with version-controlled solutions that include logging, error handling, peer review, least privilege and safe rollback.
* Build endpoint-health monitoring, compliance reporting, deployment telemetry, failure analysis and operational dashboards that improve decision-making.
* Modernize application intake, packaging, certification, deployment, patching, retirement and self-service delivery through Intune-first and automation-led practices.
* Engineer and govern enterprise browser policies, extensions, standards, lifecycle controls and controlled exceptions across Microsoft Edge, Chrome and Safari.
* Support legacy dependency remediation, including IE Mode, embedded-browser, URL, script, certificate and application compatibility dependencies.
* Produce complete engineering documentation, including requirements, designs, implementation plans, test plans, runbooks, RACI assignments, support procedures, evidence and decision records.
* Ensure production readiness through monitoring, knowledge transfer, support ownership, recovery procedures, lifecycle plans and measurable service objectives.
* Act as a technical authority and escalation point for complex endpoint issues, high-severity vulnerabilities, major changes and transformation initiatives.
* Mentor engineers and coordinate delivery across Security, Architecture, IAM, Network, Cloud, VDI, Service Desk, application teams, vendors and managed-service partners.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Typically 12 or more years of progressive infrastructure or EUC engineering experience, including ownership of complex enterprise implementations.
* Advanced experience with Microsoft Intune and Configuration Manager/SCCM in co-managed, hybrid or migration environments.
* Strong knowledge of Windows endpoint architecture, provisioning, servicing, policy, security, application deployment and troubleshooting.
* Working knowledge of macOS and mobile management using Jamf and/or Intune MDM/MAM, Apple Business Manager and platform compliance capabilities.
* Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Group Policy, Conditional Access dependencies, modern authentication, certificates and PKI concepts.
* Hands-on automation experience with PowerShell, Microsoft Graph and REST APIs, plus familiarity with source control and structured release practices.
* Experience with application packaging and deployment technologies such as Win32 applications, MSI and MSIX, including detection, requirements, dependencies and supersedence.
* Knowledge of endpoint security technologies and concepts including Microsoft Defender, BitLocker, LAPS, Windows Hello for Business, application control and attack-surface reduction.
* Experience with IT service management, change control, incident and problem management, configuration management and production support in a regulated enterprise.

**Preferred Experience**

* Engineering endpoint services at global scale across multiple regions, business units and device types.
* Windows Autopilot, Windows Autopatch, Company Portal, Cloud Management Gateway, tenant attach, Cloud PC or virtual desktop integration.
* Browser governance, Chrome Enterprise Core, enterprise site lists, extension controls and legacy-browser dependency remediation.
* Application packaging automation, test automation, digital employee experience, proactive remediation or self-healing workflows.
* ServiceNow, Power BI, Azure DevOps or comparable workflow, backlog, reporting and portfolio-management platforms.
* Cryptographic inventory, certificate and trust dependency management, crypto-agility or post-quantum readiness planning.
* Relevant Microsoft, Azure, security, Apple/Jamf or ITIL certifications.

PROFESSIONAL COMPETENCIES
  
  

* End-to-end ownership, sound risk judgment and ability to drive work from requirements through stable operational handoff.
* Strong systems thinking with the ability to assess impacts across identity, network, security, applications, support and user experience.
* Disciplined engineering practices including standards, reusable patterns, testing, peer review, documentation and measurable acceptance criteria.
* Clear written and verbal communication with the ability to explain technical decisions, risks and trade-offs to engineers, partners and senior leaders.
* Ability to collaborate across organizational boundaries while maintaining clear accountability, decision rights and delivery commitments.
* Continuous-improvement mindset focused on eliminating recurring issues, automating repetitive work and reducing technical debt.

**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Pune Office**
The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: GPP SME
description:
**Company Description**
CloudColon is a premier technology consulting firm that helps organizations accelerate digital transformation through AI, cloud, and modern enterprise technologies. The company combines a business-first consulting approach with deep technical expertise to deliver scalable, secure, and innovative solutions that drive measurable outcomes. Core capabilities span Salesforce implementations, data science and AI, DevOps and cloud modernization, full stack development, and payment solution integration and optimization. With 120+ certifications and experienced architects, consultants, and engineers, CloudColon delivers enterprise-grade solutions that modernize technology, optimize operations, and enhance customer experiences. CloudColon partners with clients to build intelligent, future-ready solutions that unlock the full potential of AI and digital technologies.

**GPP SME – Roles, Responsibilities & Deliverables**

The GPP SME will provide deep functional and technical expertise in Finastra Global PAYplus (FGPP), supporting rule configuration, payment processing, production issue resolution, and client implementations.

Key Responsibilities & Deliverables

**GPP Rules & Configuration**
: Configure and maintain payment rules, routing, validation, processing parameters, system controls, and other FGPP configurations based on business requirements and payment schemes.

**Production Issue Analysis & Resolution**
: Analyze and troubleshoot complex production issues, identify root causes, perform impact analysis, and drive issues to resolution in collaboration with development, product, and support teams.

**Deep GPP System Expertise**
: Demonstrate strong knowledge of FGPP architecture, payment processing workflows, business rules, configurations, interfaces, and end-to-end payment lifecycle.

**Client Engagement**
: Work directly with clients to understand business requirements, provide functional guidance, recommend best practices, and resolve complex product-related queries.

Implementation & Testing Support: Support system setup, configuration validation, SIT/UAT, defect triage, regression testing, and production readiness.

**Payment Analysis & Troubleshooting**
: Investigate payment processing failures, exceptions, validation errors, routing issues, and message/interface-related problems.

Risk & Stakeholder Management : Identify implementation and production risks, communicate status and dependencies, and coordinate with relevant stakeholders for timely resolution.

**Knowledge Management:**
Maintain configuration documents, troubleshooting guides, root-cause analysis reports, and technical/functional documentation.

**Technical & Functional Collaboration**
: Work closely with development, QA, product, and support teams to resolve complex FGPP issues and drive product improvements.

**Implementation & Post-Production Support:**
Provide go-live, production stabilization, and post-implementation support, ensuring smooth transition to business-as-usual operations.

**Knowledge Sharing**
: Mentor internal teams, share FGPP domain expertise, and contribute to training and capability development.

title: Data Center Infrastructure Specialist
description:
NVIDIA is looking for a Data Center Deployment Specialist to join its Professional Services team. Academic and commercial groups around the world are using NVIDIA products to revolutionize deep learning and data analytics, and to power data centers. Join the team building many of the largest and fastest data centers in the world! NVIDIA is looking for someone with the ability to work on a dynamic customer-focused team that requires excellent interpersonal skills.
  
  
As a Data Center Infrastructure Specialist, you will be interacting with customers, partners, and internal teams, to analyse, define and implement large scale Datacenter projects. The scope of these efforts includes a combination of Datacenter Infrastructure design and cluster deployment planning.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**

* Design and implement flawless data center infrastructure solutions to meet the needs of our customers.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure the successful deployment of data center infrastructure.
* Datacenter Planning: Floor Plan, Rack Elevation, Simulation
* Cable deployment planning including - ensuring requirements are accurate such as number and type of connections, port assignments, and timing of activity while following standard methodologies, Point-to-Point Design.
* Deploy and Support NVIDIA products.
* Validating and updating all related work instructions for Datacenter activities.
* Responsible for providing input for Data Center Standards updates as required; balancing multiple activities and priorities; participate in projects calls.
* Documenting processes and keeping event logs.
* Escort and oversee on-site work delivered by partners and third-party vendors.

**What We Need To See**

* 5+ years of proven experience as a data center infrastructure engineer, field service engineer or similar with background in designing and implementing data center infrastructures.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field.
* In-depth knowledge of data center environments, servers, and network equipment.
* Extensive experience in installing, monitoring, and maintaining data center equipment.
* Solid understanding of networking, storage, and virtualization technologies.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to work as part of a team, in a fast and highly dynamic environment.
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency in documenting processes.
* Willingness to travel.

**Way To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Network certification such as: CCIE
* Knowledge with InfiniBand Technology
* Collaboration with R&D and network engineering teams.
* Outstanding interpersonal skill.

NVIDIA is considered one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hard-working people in the world, working for us. Our commitment to pushing boundaries and delivering exceptional solutions is unparalleled. As a Data Center Infrastructure Specialist, you will play a key role in shaping the future of computing and driving the success of our clients. At NVIDIA, we are an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive work environment for all employees. If you are a proactive and driven individual, creative with a strong interest in current technology trends, this is the opportunity you have been waiting for. Join us at NVIDIA and be part of our journey to shape the future of computing. Apply now and let's work together to make a difference!

title: System Expert VNDLY
description:
**Life tastes better with ice cream**
With 19.000 expert ice cream colleagues and iconic brands like Wall’s, Cornetto and Ben & Jerry’s, loved in 76 countries, we are the world’s largest Ice Cream company leading the industry.
  
  
We create iconic ice cream brands that are part of everyday life, bringing moments of joy to millions of people around the world. Everybody loves ice cream. And as the world’s biggest pure‑play ice cream company, we have the scale and ambition to make a real difference.
  
  
**What Truly Sets Us Apart Is How We Work.**
We move fast and keep things simple. We turn ideas into action, trust people to take ownership, and work as one team to win together with integrity. Our culture is high‑performance, collaborative and focused on getting things done.
  
  
We’re curious and ready for what’s next. We embrace digital, use data to make better decisions, and keep learning, including how AI can help us work smarter and serve consumers better.
  
  
The role We are building a best-in-class HR Technology landscape to support the future of the Ice Cream Company. This role acts as the functional and technical expert for VNDLY, our contingent workforce management platform, ensuring it is stable, compliant, and continuously optimized to support our global contingent workforce. The role will own the end-to-end VNDLY solution, covering vendor management, contingent worker lifecycle, integrations with Workday and downstream systems, and ongoing enhancements. It plays a critical role in enabling a seamless, compliant, and scalable external workforce model across all markets. What you'll be responsible for Own and manage the VNDLY platform as a global HR Technology subject matter expert. Manage VNDLY configuration, workflows, data structures, access roles, system performance, and roadmap alignment. Support the complete contingent workforce lifecycle: requisition, onboarding, time tracking, invoicing, and offboarding. Drive process standardization and best practices across global markets. Manage integrations between VNDLY, Workday Core HCM, Finance/invoicing systems, and reporting platforms. Ensure data accuracy, system connectivity, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis for integration issues. Act as the key link between business stakeholders and AMS partners for operational support. Manage incidents, service requests, enhancements, SLAs, and continuous improvements. Identify and implement VNDLY process improvements, automation opportunities, and user experience enhancements. Support release management activities, including impact assessment, UAT coordination, deployment, and hypercare. Maintain system governance, documentation, compliance, and audit readiness. Support contingent workforce reporting and analytics, including headcount, spend, vendor performance, and compliance metrics. Ensure reporting and dashboards are accurate, timely, and aligned with business needs. We're looking for someone who 5+ years of experience in HR Technology / HR Systems. 1–3+ years of hands-on experience with VNDLY and contingent workforce solutions. Strong knowledge of external workforce lifecycle and HR processes. Experience with HR system integrations, with Workday integration expertise preferred. Expertise in VNDLY configuration, operations, and support. Experience working in global, multi-country HR environments. Understanding of contingent workforce compliance and vendor management. Experience with AMS support models (L2/L3). Ability to translate business requirements into system solutions. Strong collaboration skills across HR, Procurement, Finance, and IT stakeholders. Strategic thinker with a proactive approach and strong problem-solving skills. Excellent communication, presentation, organization, and time management skills. Ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. High level of integrity, professionalism, and analytical ability. Fluency in English required. What you'll get Alongside meaningful work and strong development, we offer a reward package that typically includes Market-competitive pay and performance related rewards Flexible ways of working Support for health, wellbeing and life outside of work Time off to rest and recharge Ongoing learning and development opportunities Specific benefits vary by location
  
  
**Why join us?**
This is a place for people who are passionate about ice cream and are growth obsessed - both for the business and for themselves. People who act like an owner and drive our business end-to-end. People who are driven by success to deliver more than we ever thought we could!
  
  
You’ll thrive here if you value an inclusive culture, with low ego and hierarchy - and if you’re excited to continuously learn and challenge how we work, using digital, data, and new thinking to push us forward.
  
  

* Roles with real accountability and visible impact
* Free to move fast, experiment and challenge how things are done
* Continuous learning and development as the business grows
* Reward linked to performance and contribution.

Your career here is shaped by what you deliver, as you work across functions and markets and grow with the business.
  
  
**Ready to build the future of Ice Cream?**
If this sounds like the place where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you. Apply online and share your CV. We'll review your application and be in touch with the next steps.
  
  
If you are an individual with a disability and require assistance at any time during our recruitment process, please let your Talent Acquisition Partner know.
  
  
**Additional Information**
The Magnum Ice Cream Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work regardless of age, disability, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.

title: Technical Implementation Engineer
description:

**Technical Implementation Engineer — Customer Solutions & Integrations**
**Role summary:**
Sits between Technical Implementation and Engineering — owns technical onboarding, data ingestion, and custom integration work for customers on the platform (ETM/VMDR context), with enough coding and
**AI-tooling fluency to automate repetitive implementation work rather than doing it manually each time.**
**Note - Relocation to Pune is required for this role, Role may involve Night shifts. We work 3 days from Office in a week.**

* Core Responsibilities

+ Data ingestion & onboarding: Build and validate CSV/bulk data ingestion pipelines into ETM (asset data, business context, criticality tags, third-party vulnerability feeds)
+ API-based integrations: Build custom solutions using Qualys APIs and third-party APIs (ServiceNow, Jira, Tenable, Rapid7, Defender, SIEM/SOAR platforms, ticketing systems)
+ Customer-facing technical work: Join customer calls to scope integration requirements, troubleshoot live issues, and walk technical stakeholders (network/security/IT teams) through implementation steps
+ Automation of implementation work itself: Use AI agents/scripting to templatize and speed up recurring implementation tasks (data mapping, connector setup, validation checks) rather than repeating manual work per customer
+ Documentation & handoff: Produce clean runbooks/config docs so Support and the customer's own team can maintain the integration post-go-live

* AI & Agentic Automation - The engineer will be expected to use modern AI tooling as an engineering productivity layer. The role should be capable of evaluating and building workflows where AI/agents can assist with implementation activities such as:

+ Understanding customer integration requirements.
+ Mapping customer schemas to Qualys schemas.
+ Generating transformation logic.
+ Creating API integration code.
+ Analysing integration errors and logs.
+ Generating configuration templates.
+ Validating implementation prerequisites.
+ Generating customer-specific implementation documentation.
+ Performing repetitive implementation checks.
+ Building internal agents that execute controlled implementation workflows.
+ Experience with tools such as GPT-based agents, Claude-based workflows, RAG, function/tool calling, MCP-style integrations, RPA, or similar automation frameworks is valuable.
+ The expectation is not that the engineer is an AI researcher.
+ The expectation is that they understand how to apply AI safely and practically to reduce implementation effort and increase implementation consistency.

* Required Qualifications:

+ Mimimum 3 years of working experience
+ Programming proficiency (Python strongly preferred — scripting, API clients, data transformation)
+ Solid REST API experience (auth flows, pagination, rate limits, webhook handling)
+ Comfortable with CSV/structured data manipulation and data validation at scale
+ Working knowledge of at least one ticketing/ITSM platform integration (ServiceNow, Jira, Remedy)
+ Experience or strong aptitude with AI agent tooling (e.g., building/using agents for workflow automation — could be internal tooling, Claude/GPT-based agents, or RPA-adjacent tools)
+ Strong verbal communication — able to run technical discussions directly with customer engineering/network teams, not just write code

* Preferred Qualifications:

+ Prior exposure to Qualys VMDR/ETM, or a comparable VM platform (Tenable, Rapid7, Qualys competitors)
+ Experience with SOAR platforms or security automation
+ Familiarity with cloud platform APIs (AWS/Azure/GCP) for asset ingestion
+ Basic understanding of vulnerability management workflows (so they understand why the data matters, not just how to move it)

title: Senior System Administrator - Windchill
description:
Edwards Lifesciences is expanding its global technology capabilities with the launch of a new IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India. The Hub strengthens the technology foundation that supports our business worldwide, working in close partnership with teams across regions to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions at scale.
  
  
Designed as a long-term investment, the Pune Hub will advance newer digital capabilities such as automation, data, AI, and cloud, and will include roles spanning end user services, application development, and enterprise platform teams.
  
  
The Senior System Administrator is responsible for defining, administering, and maintaining the hardware, software, and environments for PLM, Regulatory, R&D and Clinical systems required to support Edwards’ business transformation from development through production. This role collaborates with Architects and Application Owners to create and manage system environments, supports administration and maintenance, defines release management, source code control, build and deployment procedures, and ensures environments are available, secure, compliant, and performing as expected. The role works closely with cross-functional IT, Infrastructure, Compliance, Configuration, Development, vendor, and business teams to maintain system availability, support upgrades, execute deployments, manage backups and disaster recovery planning, and maintain infrastructure-related validation documentation.
  
  
**How will you make an impact:**

* Administer, install, update, optimize, debug, and maintain PTC Windchill applications and related system environments across development, test, certification, and production.
* Lead and Manage application administration activities across the lifecycle, including vendor coordination, installation, data import, upgrades, user issue resolution, permissions and roles, backups, automation, and application retirement.
* Define, maintain, and execute source code management, release management, deployment, and configuration management work instructions to support Configuration and Development teams.
* Build releases, including weekly, on-demand, and snapshot releases for local instances, and support code deployments, configuration changes, code review, and test coordination.
* Plan, configure, document, and support high availability, backup, security, SSL certificate, HTTPS, LDAPS, disaster recovery, and environment readiness requirements.
* Provide guidance on non-functional requirements, including performance, load testing, benchmarking, scalability, resilience, and operational readiness.
* Perform Windchill system maintenance activities, including upgrades, patches, security vulnerability remediation, new release installation, daily and weekly maintenance plans, WinDU, WinRU, revaulting, and environment refresh or rehosting.
* Maintain Windchill vault space, administer CAD and Office workers, perform log and temporary file cleanup and rotation, and support remote file server setup and maintenance.
* Review Server Manager, Method Server, and other Windchill logs for issues; administer, monitor, and report through PTC System Monitor.
* Write and maintain deployment scripts, coordinate environment resources and schedules, monitor CPU, RAM, and disk space growth, and plan for expansion or cleanup as needed.
* Lead and Perform issue resolution, root cause analysis, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement to strengthen system stability and reduce recurring issues.
* Support coordinated patching, hotfix, and vulnerability remediation activities for Oracle RDC/Clinical and SAS Analytics platforms across OS, application, and database layers, partnering with IT Database and Infrastructure teams to strengthen compliance, stability, and risk mitigation.
* Author and maintain system administration, infrastructure, validation, work instruction, deployment, and environment maintenance documentation to support compliance and audit readiness.
* Provide on-call critical support and partner with Tier 1 and Tier 2 analysts, application users, vendors, and cross-functional teams to resolve issues and maintain service levels.
* Lead and mentor junior/new team members by providing technical guidance, ensuring adherence to support processes, and driving the creation and maintenance of high-quality technical documentation, knowledge articles, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

**What you'll need (Required):**

* Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related IT discipline.
* 5–7 years of related working experience in PTC Windchill v12.0.1 or above system administration.
* 5–7 years of IT experience demonstrating solid performance while working with cross-functional IT and business teams on enterprise-level or complex system implementations.
* Hands-on experience administering Windchill environments across development, test, certification, and production, including installation, upgrades, patching, configuration, monitoring, troubleshooting, and maintenance.
* Experience with Windchill maintenance and administration activities such as WinDU, WinRU, revaulting, vault space management, CAD and Office worker administration, remote file server maintenance, and log review.
* Experience supporting source code management, release management, build and deployment procedures, deployment scripting, environment refreshes, and configuration changes.
* Experience supporting high availability, backup, security, SSL certificate, HTTPS, LDAPS, disaster recovery, performance, load testing, and system monitoring requirements.
* Experience supporting Oracle RDC/Clinical and SAS Analytics platform patching or hotfix activities across OS, application, and database layers, including coordination with IT Database and Infrastructure teams on implementation, vulnerability remediation, compliance, stability, and risk mitigation efforts.
* Strong troubleshooting, debugging, analytical, detail-oriented, organizational, and information-seeking skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, interpersonal relationship skills, and ability to interact professionally with all organizational levels.

**What else we look for (Preferred):**

* Experience working in multi-workstream development environments using DevOps CI/CD tools and methodologies, with working knowledge of JIRA and GitLab.
* Experience in Codebeamer administration, configuration, workflow management, or integration with enterprise engineering and ALM processes.
* Technical skills in Java, JSP, JavaScript, XML, JSON, SQL, PL/SQL, SOAP, RESTful Web Services, Python, and relevant code development languages and concepts.
* Experience with enterprise application and platform administration across Windows Server, IIS Web Server, Apache Tomcat, RHEL/Linux administration, Microsoft .NET, SSL certificate management, load balancers, routing, firewall concepts, access control, networking, and communication protocols.
* Working knowledge of Oracle SQL queries, Oracle APEX administration, Oracle DB 19c, SOLR or search engine indexing concepts, Aras PLM, SAS Administration, AWS servers, and patch management.
* Experience in medical device, pharmaceutical, highly regulated, or corporate enterprise environments.
* Excellent organization and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and work toward long-term goals.
* Strong relationship management, negotiation, and collaboration skills, with the ability to drive achievement of objectives across teams.
* Substantial knowledge and understanding of computer science fundamentals.
* Strict attention to detail and ability to work independently in a complex enterprise support environment.
