title: Application Support Engineer – Windows, PowerShell & SQL Server
description:
**Overall Responsibilities:**
 Synechron is seeking an L3 Application Support \& Development Analyst with 8–10 years of experience in application and production support. The role will maintain the stability, availability, and performance of critical applications in Windows environments while using PowerShell automation to improve operational efficiency.
   

  

 The analyst will troubleshoot complex issues, support releases and upgrades, perform root\-cause analysis, and collaborate with development, infrastructure, database, and business teams. The position is based in Pune and requires working from the office three days per week.
   

  

**Skills:**
* PowerShell scripting and automation.
* Windows command\-line tools.
* SQL for querying and troubleshooting.

* 8\+ years of application or production support experience.
* Strong PowerShell scripting and automation experience.
* Windows Server 2016, 2019, and/or 2022\.
* IIS administration.
* Windows Services, Active Directory, Task Scheduler, and Event Viewer.
* Application, middleware, and server troubleshooting.
* SQL Server and practical SQL query debugging.
* Monitoring, deployment, patching, and release support.

Integrates subject matter and industry expertise within a defined area. Requires in\-depth understanding of how areas collectively integrate within the sub\-function as well as coordinate and contribute to the objectives of the function and overall business. title: IFC - Service Engineer
description:
Join us as IFC \- Service Engineer, at Barclays, where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting\-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.
   

  

 To be successful as IFC \- Service Engineer, you should have experience with:
   

  

  

* Experience on Relational Databases, particularly MSSQL/ Oracle (with exposure to writing queries, tuning concepts, stored procedures) and Unix Shell/ Python script.
* Experience of Cloud technologies, AWS, OpenShift/APIs.
* Experience of Monitoring \& Observability tools \- Geneos ITRS, AppDynamics and scheduling Tools – TWS and/or Autosys.
* Actively tune monitoring tools, thresholds, and alerting to ensure issues are known when they occur and focus on intelligent alerting with a business context.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* Experience/ knowledge of CI\-CD pipeline – Gitlab automation, Hadoop, GenAI.
* Prior experience and knowledge of Banking domain, Financial Crime/ AML.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills with the ability to analyse complex situations and deliver effective solutions.


 The role is based out of Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To effectively monitor and maintain the bank’s critical technology infrastructure and resolve more complex technical issues, whilst minimising disruption to operations.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Provision of technical support for the service management function to resolve more complex issues for a specific client of group of clients. Develop the support model and service offering to improve the service to customers and stakeholders.
* Execution of preventative maintenance tasks on hardware and software and utilisation of monitoring tools/metrics to identify, prevent and address potential issues and ensure optimal performance.
* Maintenance of a knowledge base containing detailed documentation of resolved cases for future reference, self\-service opportunities and knowledge sharing.
* Analysis of system logs, error messages and user reports to identify the root causes of hardware, software and network issues, and providing a resolution to these issues by fixing or replacing faulty hardware components, reinstalling software, or applying configuration changes.
* Automation, monitoring enhancements, capacity management, resiliency, business continuity management, front office specific support and stakeholder management.
* Identification and remediation or raising, through appropriate process, of potential service impacting risks and issues.
* Proactively assess support activities implementing automations where appropriate to maintain stability and drive efficiency. Actively tune monitoring tools, thresholds, and alerting to ensure issues are known when they occur.


**Analyst Expectations**
* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in\-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub\-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Cloud Service Operations Engineer (*Windchill Support)
description:
Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.
   

  

 Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Associate Engineer – Windchill Cloud is responsible for supporting the deployment, configuration, maintenance, and upgrade of PTC Windchill applications hosted in cloud environments. Working under the guidance of senior engineers, the role focuses on delivering reliable cloud services, resolving technical issues, and ensuring compliance with PTC Cloud standards, security practices, and operational procedures.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Installation \& Deployment**
* Assist in deploying Windchill applications, build packages, CCDs, CPS, Maintenance Releases (MRs), temporary patches and Rehost.
* Validate deployments and resolve basic deployment issues.


**Configuration \& Maintenance**
* Configure Windchill and supporting components according to PTC Cloud standards.
* Perform routine system administration tasks, including log cleanup, cache management, index rebuilding, health checks, and service validation.


**Upgrades \& Support**
* Assist in executing Windchill version upgrades, CPS, and MR updates.
* Perform post\-upgrade validation and basic troubleshooting.
* Investigate application, publishing, and deployment issues, escalating complex problems as required.


**Customer \& Operational Support**
* Support customer change requests, scheduled maintenance, and production activities.
* Maintain technical documentation, deployment records, and knowledge articles.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure timely service delivery and customer satisfaction.


**Required Skills**
* Basic knowledge of PTC Windchill PLM and cloud concepts.
* Familiarity with Linux, Windows Server, Apache, Tomcat, Oracle Database, and SQL.
* Basic scripting knowledge (Shell/PowerShell).
* Understanding of deployment, troubleshooting, and system administration.
* Strong analytical, communication, and problem\-solving skills.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS/Azure) and Windchill administration is an added advantage.


 Life at PTC is about more than working with today’s most cutting\-edge technologies to transform the physical world. It’s about showing up as you are and working alongside some of today’s most talented industry leaders to transform the world around you.
   

  

 If you share our passion for problem\-solving through innovation, you’ll likely become just as passionate about the PTC experience as we are. Are you ready to explore your next career move with us?
   

  

 We respect the privacy rights of individuals and are committed to handling Personal Information responsibly and in accordance with all applicable privacy and data protection laws. Review our Privacy Policy here."

title: Senior Administrator, Financial Systems & Automation (NetSuite)
description:
**Our Mission**
 You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.
   

  

 We’re here to give power to the patient.
   

  

 For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace \- helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.
   

  

 Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from
 *seeking* 
 to
 *getting* 
 . We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.
   

  

 Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.
   

  

**Your Impact on our mission**
 Healthcare is too hard. At Zocdoc, we work every day to make it easier for patients to get the care they need.
   

  

 As Senior Administrator, Financial Systems \& Automation, you’ll help ensure that the systems supporting Zocdoc’s financial operations are reliable, secure, scalable, and easy to use. You’ll own the Finance Applications service experience from intake through resolution, serve as a hands\-on NetSuite expert, and help improve the connected tools and processes that Finance and Accounting rely on every day.
   

  

 This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys solving practical systems problems, improving how work gets done, and taking ownership from the first request through the final outcome.
   

  

**You’ll enjoy this role if you are**
* Energised by owning a system, service queue, or project from beginning to end
* Comfortable making thoughtful decisions when requirements are incomplete or priorities change
* Motivated by turning ambiguous problems into clear next steps
* Someone stakeholders trust for NetSuite guidance, issue resolution, and process improvement
* Structured and consistent in your approach to SLAs, documentation, testing, and follow\-through
* Curious about automation and responsible uses of AI
* Comfortable balancing speed, user experience, data integrity, security, and financial controls


**Your day\-to\-day is**
**Own Finance Applications service delivery**
* Manage the Finance Applications Jira queue from intake and triage through prioritization, communication, escalation, resolution, validation, and closure
* Track backlog, aging, blocked work, SLA risk, reopen rates, and recurring issues, taking action before commitments are missed
* Clarify incomplete requests, set realistic expectations, provide proactive updates, and close the loop with requesters
* Improve Jira Service Management workflows, dashboards, reporting, intake quality, knowledge articles, and escalation practices


**Administer and improve NetSuite**
* Configure and support NetSuite workflows, approvals, roles and permissions, saved searches, reports, forms, and related functionality
* Translate Finance and Accounting requirements into practical solutions that improve accuracy, control, scalability, and user experience
* Investigate transaction, reporting, access, workflow, and integration issues and determine the appropriate resolution path
* Coordinate sandbox validation, regression testing, release readiness, production deployment, and post\-change verification
* Maintain documentation for configurations, dependencies, operating procedures, and support guidance


**Lead projects and continuous improvement**
* Manage financial\-systems projects from discovery and requirements through planning, testing, implementation, rollout, and follow\-up
* Define outcomes, scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, owners, decisions, and next steps
* Coordinate contributors across Finance, Accounting, FP\&A, IT, Engineering, and external vendors
* Identify blockers early, recommend practical paths forward, and escalate with context and a proposed decision
* Deliver measurable improvements in reliability, efficiency, data quality, user experience, or control effectiveness


**Strengthen automation, controls, and documentation**
* Identify repetitive, manual, or error\-prone processes that can be improved through configuration, automation, controls, or clearer documentation
* Investigate data mismatches, integration failures, and process breaks using reports, logs, testing, and root\-cause analysis
* Build or improve dashboards and operational reporting for service delivery, system health, project progress, and process performance
* Follow change\-management, access\-management, segregation\-of\-duties, and audit\-readiness practices
* Maintain runbooks, knowledge articles, process documentation, testing evidence, and handoff materials


**You’ll be successful in this role if you have**
* 5\+years of experience in financial systems, ERP administration, finance operations technology, or a related field
* Strong hands\-on NetSuite administration and configuration experience, including workflows, approvals, roles and permissions, saved searches, reporting, forms, and troubleshooting
* Experience owning a service queue, ticketing process, or internal systems\-support function against defined SLAs
* Experience with Jira or Jira Service Management, including queues, workflows, dashboards, reporting, intake, escalation, or automation
* Demonstrated ability to independently manage projects, coordinate stakeholders, and deliver results with limited day\-to\-day supervision
* Strong analytical and root\-cause problem\-solving skills across systems, data, and business processes
* Experience managing external vendor support cases with clear documentation, urgency, and follow\-through
* Experience with system testing, release management, change control, production validation, and operational documentation
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical issues and decisions to non\-technical stakeholders
* A track record of ownership, sound judgment, proactive risk escalation, and strong internal customer service
* A bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, Business, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* NetSuite Administrator certification
* Experience with connected finance platforms such as Coupa, Planful, ADP, Salesforce, or banking systems
* Experience translating business needs into requirements, action plans, decisions, and validation plans
* Experience influencing without authority across Finance, Accounting, IT, Engineering, vendors, and distributed teams
* Experience using automation or AI tools to improve finance operations, documentation, reporting, or user support


**What Success Looks Like**
* Finance Applications requests are visible, actively managed, and resolved against agreed service commitments
* Requesters receive timely communication, clear expectations, and complete resolution documentation
* NetSuite configurations and workflows are reliable, well governed, well documented, and aligned to business needs
* Financial\-systems projects move forward with clear ownership, decisions, milestones, and measurable outcomes
* Recurring issues and manual work decrease through root\-cause fixes, automation, and process improvements
* Stakeholders trust you to make progress, navigate ambiguity, and escalate risks early


**Benefits**
* An incredible team of smart and supportive people
* A competitive compensation package, including attractive medical insurance
* Flexible, hybrid work environment
* Amazing perks – think catered lunch every day, Ping Pong, etc.
* Daycare reimbursement
* The chance to create a better healthcare experience for millions of patients!
* Corporate wellness programs with Headspace
* Cellphone and wifi reimbursement
* Competitive parental leave
* Sabbatical leave (over 5 years)
* Annual sponsored health check\-ups
* Sponsored counselling and therapy via Betterlyf
* Competitive PTO
* Zocdoc is certified as a Great Place to Work 2022\-2026


**About Us**
 Zocdoc is the country’s leading digital health marketplace that helps patients easily find and book the care they need. Each month, millions of patients use our free service to find nearby, in\-network providers, compare choices based on verified patient reviews, and instantly book in\-person or video visits online. Providers participate in Zocdoc’s Marketplace to reach new patients to grow their practice, fill their last\-minute openings, and deliver a better healthcare experience. title: Intern
description:
**We’re hiring at Pitney Bowes, where top talent builds meaningful careers and lasting impact. We Move fast, Deliver excellence, and Win together…that’s The Pitney Bowes way. Here, how we work matters just as much as what we achieve.**
**We’re Looking For People Who**
* Act with urgency, accountability, and purpose
* Deliver high quality work with consistency and pride
* Collaborate effectively and elevate those around them
* Focus on outcomes that drive impact and growth


**Job Description**
**Join Pitney Bowes as an Intern
   

  

 Location: Pune (Hybrid\- 3days/week in\-office)
   

  

 Role: Third Party(contractual)**
**About The Role**
 We are seeking enthusiastic and self\-driven engineers with strong fundamentals, curiosity and automation mindset in Network Operations, Automation, DevOps, and Infrastructure Monitoring.
   

  

 This role is focused on building a modern, automation\-first Network Operations Center (NOC) rather than a traditional helpdesk environment.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should possess strong analytical skills, networking fundamentals, and an interest in scripting, observability, and automation technologies.
   

  

* Responsibilities DevOps (Modern NOC \- Automation \& Continuous Improvement)
* Assist in automation of monitoring and operational workflows through basic scripting.
* Support infrastructure and network change monitoring as part of CI/CD pipelines.
* Work with monitoring and observability tools (e.g. Grafana)
* Contribute to infrastructure improvements using automation/orchestration principles.
* Develop basic scripts (Python / PowerShell) to reduce manual effort.
* Work with APIs and structured data formats (JSON)
* Support automation initiatives and process optimisation efforts.
* Build foundational understanding of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and CI/CD practices.


**Network Operations \- Incident Management \& Coordination**
* Monitor network, systems, and infrastructure (LAN/WAN, Wireless, VPN, firewalls, cloud) in a 24x7 environment using standard NOC tools.
* Detect, triage, and respond to alerts, incidents, and outages with defined SLAs.
* Perform first\-level troubleshooting across network and system components (routers, switches, wireless, firewalls, circuits)
* Log, track, and manage incidents via ticketing tools (JIRA, ServiceNow etc.)
* Follow established SOPs for troubleshooting and escalation to L2/L3 teams.
* Collaborate with internal teams (Network, Security, Application, Cloud) and external vendors/ISPs for issue resolution.
* Perform routine operational tasks such as configuration backups, patching, upgrades, and health checks.
* Support network changes, validation, and implementation activities.


**Documentation \& Reporting**
* Maintain accurate incident records, RCA documentation, and network artefacts.
* Generate periodic reports on uptime, alerts, and performance trends.
* Update SOPs, runbooks, and internal knowledge base consistently.
* Key Skills \& Background


**Networking Fundamentals (Must\-Have)**
* Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, Routing \& Switching
* Basic understanding of firewall and network security concepts
* Familiarity with WAN, VPN, and Internet connectivity
* Exposure to enterprise network devices (routers, switches, firewalls)
* Experience or exposure to monitoring tools (LogicMonitor, SolarWinds, ManageEngine, etc.)


**Troubleshooting \& Analytical Skills**
* Ability to perform initial fault isolation and structured troubleshooting.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving capability and willingness to learn.


**DevOps / Automation (Must\-Have)**
* Scripting skills (Python, Bash, PowerShell)
* Awareness of automation tools (Ansible, Terraform, GitHub) and CI/CD concepts.
* Understanding of cloud fundamentals (AWS/Azure/GCP)
* Basic working knowledge of Linux and Windows operating systems
* Awareness of REST API, Webhook, CSV, Jason etc.


**Soft Skills**
* Strong communication and stakeholder coordination skills
* Ability to work in a 24x7 shift\-based NOC environment.
* Good documentation discipline and attention to detail.
* Ability to perform under pressure during incidents and outages.
* Education \& Experience
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science / IT / Electronics or equivalent
* 0–2 years of experience (freshers with relevant certifications can be considered)


**Preferred Certifications (Not Mandatory)**
* CCNA / Network\+
* DevNet Associate
* ITIL Foundation
* Entry\-level Cloud or DevOps certifications (optional)


**What We Are Looking For**
 Individuals with strong learning aptitude, engineering mindset, and passion for building reliable and automated infrastructure operations.
   

  

 Note: This is not a traditional helpdesk or ticket\-routing role. Candidates should be interested in automation, observability, and continuous improvement.
   

  

**About Pitney Bowes**
 Pitney Bowes (NYSE: PBI) is a global shipping and mailing company that provides technology, logistics, and financial services to more than 90 percent of the Fortune 500\. Small business, retail, enterprise, and government clients around the world rely on Pitney Bowes to remove the complexity of sending mail and parcels. For additional information visit Pitney Bowes at www.pitneybowes.com.
   

  

**We Will**
* Provide the will: opportunity to grow and develop your career
* Offer an inclusive environment that encourages diverse perspectives and ideas
* Deliver challenging and unique opportunities to contribute to the success of a transforming organization
* Offer comprehensive benefits globally (PB Benefits and Wellbeing Programs)


 Pitney Bowes is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusiveness in the workplace.
   

  

 All interested individuals must apply online.

title: Engineer L1
description:
**About Us**
 We are a global climate technologies company engineered for sustainability. We create sustainable and efficient residential, commercial and industrial spaces through HVACR technologies. We protect temperature\-sensitive goods throughout the cold chain. And we bring comfort to people globally. Best\-in\-class engineering, design and manufacturing combined with category\-leading brands in compression, controls, software and monitoring solutions result in next\-generation climate technology that is built for the needs of the world ahead.
   

  

 Whether you are a professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring your first opportunity, or recent graduate with an advanced degree, we have opportunities that will allow you to innovate, be challenged and make an impact. Join our team and start your journey today!
   

  

 We are looking for an Oracle IT Analyst with hands\-on functional experience beyond end\-user activities, who is motivated to build and grow a long\-term career working with Oracle E\-Business Suite.
   

  

 In this role, you will work closely with business stakeholders and technical teams to deliver stable, scalable, and business\-aligned Oracle solutions that enable efficient Procure\-to\-Pay and Order to Cash operations and continuous process improvement.
   

  

 This job is based in Pune\- Maharashtra \- India.
   

  

 We provide a flexible working schedule with the option of working hybrid.
   

  

**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be**
 Gather, analyze, and document business requirements from stakeholders and translate them into functional specifications for Oracle E\-Business Suite.
   

  

 Design, configure, and support Oracle R12 SCM /Distribution modules, including Purchasing, Order Management, iProcurement, Inventory, and iSupplier, Shipping , WMS , Pricing ensuring correct setup of profile options, flexfields, and business rules.
   

  

 Map existing (“as\-is”) business processes, perform gap analysis, and design optimized (“to\-be”) processes aligned with Oracle EBS capabilities.
   

  

 Create and maintain functional documentation, including scope documents, functional design documents, use cases, process flows, and user training materials.
   

  

 Develop and execute functional test scripts and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure solutions meet business requirements.
   

  

 Provide end\-user training and ongoing functional and technical support, including issue resolution and management of Oracle Service Requests (SRs).
   

  

 Act as a key liaison between business users and technical teams, ensuring effective communication and successful delivery of IT solutions.
   

  

 Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying process efficiencies and system enhancement opportunities.
   

  

**For This Role You Will Need**
 University degree in Information Technology, Business, Supply Chain, or a related field.
   

  

 3\-5 years of hands\-on experience with Oracle E\-Business Suite R12, with strong functional expertise in Distribution (Procurement/Order Management) modules.
   

  

 Solid understanding of the Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P)/ Order to Cash(O2C) lifecycle and related supply chain business processes.
   

  

 Experience with at least one end\-to\-end Oracle implementation or multiple Oracle Procurement support projects.
   

  

 Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to work independently.
   

  

 Experience creating functional documentation and process maps.
   

  

 Working knowledge of SQL for querying tables and reading packages.
   

  

 Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart**
 Functional knowledge of ASCP AND Manufacturing modules.
   

  

 Experience working in a global or cross\-functional environment.
   

  

 Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to communicate effectively at all organizational levels.
   

  

 Proactive, pragmatic, and results\-oriented mindset.
   

  

**Our Commitment to Our People**
 Across the globe, we are united by a singular Purpose: Sustainability is no small ambition. That’s why everything we do is geared toward a sustainable future—for our generation and all those to come. Through groundbreaking innovations, HVACR technology and cold chain solutions, we are reducing carbon emissions and improving energy efficiency in spaces of all sizes, from residential to commercial to industrial.
   

  

 Our employees are our greatest strength. We believe that our culture of passion, openness, and collaboration empowers us to work toward the same goal \- to make the world a better place. We invest in the end\-to\-end development of our people, beginning at onboarding and through senior leadership, so they can thrive personally and professionally.
   

  

 Flexible and competitive benefits plans offer the right options to meet your individual/family needs. We provide employees with flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave.
   

  

 Together, we have the opportunity – and the power – to continue to revolutionize the technology behind air conditioning, heating and refrigeration, and cultivate a better future. Learn more about us and how you can join our team!
   

  

**Our Commitment to Inclusion \& Belonging**
 At Copeland, we cultivate a strong sense of inclusion and belonging where individuals of all backgrounds, and with diverse perspectives, are embraced and treated fairly to enable a stronger workforce. Our employee resource groups play an important role in culture and community building at Copeland.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 Copeland is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, political affiliation, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. We are committed to providing a workplace free of any discrimination or harassment.

title: Application Development & Support Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
 Position Overview
   

  

 The MDM Developer is a solid, independent contributor who builds and supports MDM platform features end\-to\-end. Owns features from development through production support under the “you build it, you support it” model. Works with moderate guidance from senior team members on complex design decisions but independently delivers sprint commitments and resolves production issues within their domain.
   

  

 Platform Development \& Enhancement
   

  

* Build and configure MDM platform features across assigned domains
* Implement match/merge/survivorship rules based on design specifications
* Build and maintain hierarchy structures and relationship configurations
* Build stewardship workflows and business rules per design specifications

* Execute data mapping and onboarding for new sources per established patterns
* Execute data migrations and bulk operations per migration plans
* Implement platform enhancements and optimizations
* Participate in design discussions and raise technical concerns


 Platform Modernization
   

  

* Execute modernization tasks per established plans and timelines

* Perform regression testing and report discrepancies during modernization


 Production Support, Troubleshooting \& Incident Resolution
   

  

* Own production support for features you built — resolve incidents within SLAs
* Resolve data issues within your domain; escalate cross\-system issues with root cause context

* Identify patterns in recurring issues and propose permanent fixes
* Debug data flows within your domain to identify where failures occur

* Refactor code to improve readability and performance
* Address technical debt in assigned areas

 Security \& Compliance

* 3\+ years experience with data mapping and integration tools (e.g., Informatica PowerCenter, IICS, Talend, MuleSoft)

* 2\+ years experience with log analysis and monitoring tools (e.g., Splunk, ELK Stack, Datadog, CloudWatch)
* 2\+ years experience with incident management using ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira)
* Experience working across at least 2 MDM domains

* Multi\-domain MDM experience
* Manufacturing industry experience
* Informatica MDM or Reltio platform experience
* Familiarity with event\-driven architecture and APIs
* Awareness of AI/ML applications in MDM
* Familiarity with graph database concepts
* Familiarity with workflow orchestration
* Experience working with adjacent data teams
* Agile/Scrum delivery experience

 We are looking for an experienced Oracle Fusion Lead to join our Corporate Finance Technology (CFT) team. The ideal candidate will possess strong domain knowledge, excellent problem\-solving skills, and the ability to lead and coordinate support operations effectively.

* Promote awareness of audit and compliance principles in daily operations of the team.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Communicate effectively with stakeholders to understand requirements, manage expectations, and provide timely updates on issue resolution.
* Participate in change management discussions and impact assessments for new business requirements.


**Team Leadership \& Supervision**
* Allocate and supervise work across team members, ensuring balanced workloads and timely resolution of support tickets.
* Mentor and guide junior analysts, fostering a collaborative and high\-performance team culture.
* Monitor team performance against SLAs and drive continuous improvement in support processes.


 This role offers a unique opportunity to lead a high\-performing support team, work on mission\-critical financial systems, and engage with stakeholders across the enterprise. If you are passionate about Oracle Fusion, enjoy solving complex functional challenges, and thrive in a leadership role, we invite you to be part of our transformation journey.

**Internal**
* UK Finance Accounting
* UK Finance Actuarial
* UK Corporate Functions technology


**External**
* Software Suppliers
* External Consultants

* ERP Experience: Minimum 12\+ years of hands\-on experience in Finance ERP application support, maintenance, or implementation.
* Configuration Proficiency: Strong practical knowledge of Oracle Fusion configurations.


**Preferred Knowledge \& Skills**
* Team Leadership: Proven experience in managing teams, including task allocation and performance supervision.
* Domain Exposure: Background in captive organizations within the banking, insurance, or financial services sectors.
* Innovation \& Technology: Exposure to AI enablement within Oracle Fusion modules.
* Stakeholder Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills for effective collaboration with cross\-functional stakeholders.


**Educational Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree: In any discipline, preferably in Finance or IT.
* Postgraduate Qualification: Master’s degree in Finance or equivalent certifications.

+ Oracle certifications in P2P or R2R modules.

* Collaborate with the cybersecurity team to implement enhancements and updates to the CyberArk infrastructure.

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.

description:
**Job Description**
**IT End User Services Senior Analyst**
**Position Summary**
* The IT End User Services Senior Analyst provides foundational technical support to all users. They assist in analyzing and troubleshooting issues related to end\-user computing digital assets (e.g., laptops, desktops, printers, mobile phones) and serve as a point of escalation for incidents that require local resolution. Should have knowledge network and server troubleshooting. They work alongside the Platform Service Team to support corporate infrastructure and participate in various IT projects.


**Responsibilities**
* Respond to service desk tickets and outages via phone, email, or online systems, ensuring incident management and escalation when necessary. Provide IT support for internal and external end\-users in India and remote offices/ sites.
* Build, configure, re\-image, setup, update, repair, upgrade and maintain end\-user computing devices (computers and mobile devices) to meet Vertiv’s compliance and security policies Provide second\-level user support for hardware and software issues.
* Assist in hardware and software installation/configuration according to corporate policies and guidelines.
* Aid in troubleshooting and diagnosing hardware/software errors. In\-depth knowledge of Microsoft Windows client operating systems, 11, 10, 8, 7 / Windows \& Microsoft Office up to Office 365 Suite.
* Support basic network and server troubleshooting. Coordinate with global team for immediate resolution and permanent fix plan for recurring issues.
* Provide hands\-on assistance for Audio/video conference \& meeting room devices.
* Help with local backup operations in alignment with corporate policies and support IT audit requirements.
* IT asset disposal \- sorting, and boxing of the IT peripherals, accessories, desktops, and laptops for disposal. Removal of a long\-term asset from the company's records.
* Maintain confidentiality on all user data and related information.
* Strong emphasis on Manufacturing and/or Plant experience
* Being part of Asia support team, need to attend meetings with global team weekly \& monthly for projects.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent experience.
* Lead IT End User operation and/or Customer Facing support
* 4\-7 years of experience in managing IT infrastructure setup.
* Good understanding of networking, server infrastructure, IT asset management, vendor coordination.
* Ability to create and manage IT tickets effectively is required. Experience with ServiceNow preferred

This role requires you to work in a shift pattern or non\-standard work hours as required. This may include weekend work.

 **Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Pune, Maharashtra, India** 
 .
 **Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience troubleshooting and advocating for customer needs, and triaging technical issues (e.g., hardware, software, application, operational, process).
* Experience with one common scripting or coding language (e.g., Python, shell scripting).
* Systems experience (e.g., Linux, Unix) or a similar operating system.
* Experience in operating system kernel, file systems, and TCP/IP network protocols (e.g., DNS, routing, firewalls, and load balancing concepts).
* Ability to communicate in English fluently to interact with regional customers and stakeholders.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Kubernetes or container networking experience.
* Software\-defined networking experience with public Cloud or SDN software.
* Familiarity with the HTTP protocol and APIs based on HTTP.
* Familiarity with network namespaces, how to take packet captures, and how to interpret packet captures.
* Knowledge of network specific kernel parameters (TCP keepalives, TCP windows, etc.).


**About the job** 
 The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.
   

  

 As a Technical Solutions Engineer, you will own large and important customer issues in addition to providing level two support to other support teams. You will be a part of a global team that provides 24x7 support to help customers seamlessly make the switch to Google Cloud.
   

  

 In this role, you will troubleshoot technical problems for customers with a mix of debugging, networking, system administration, updating documentation, and when needed, coding/scripting. You will make products easier to adopt and use by making improvements to the product, tools, processes and documentation. Your team is driven by customers and you will help drive the success of Google Cloud by understanding and advocating for customers’ issues.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Manage the customer’s problems through effective diagnosis, resolution, or implementation of new investigation tools to increase productivity for customer issues on Google Cloud Platform products.
* Develop knowledge of Google's product technology and underlying architectures by troubleshooting, reproducing, determining the root cause for customer reported issues.
* Work as part of a team of Engineers/Consultants that globally ensure 24 hour customer support, including a need to sometimes work non\-standard work hours or shifts.
* Act as a consultant and subject matter expert for internal stakeholders in Engineering, Sales, and customer organizations to resolve technical deployment obstacles and improve Google Cloud.
* Improve the supportability of Google Cloud networking technologies by working with product engineering teams on product launches and helping product teams understand customer issues to improve existing products.
